controls.name: Find_Lot
controls.RowSource: SELECT NMIS_AGREEMENT_LOTS.CN, NMIS_AGREEMENT_LOTS.ID, NMIS_PRODUCTS.PRODUCT_CLASS AS Agr_Class, Species_Products_with_SizeSpecString.SIZE_SPEC_STRING, Source_Lot_ID_and_Source_string.ID_SOURCE2 AS Source, NMIS_AGREEMENTS.CLIENT_ASSOCIATE, NMIS_AGREEMENTS.AMOUNT_REQUESTED AS [Req (M)], [NMIS_AGREEMENT_LOTS].[BEGIN_FY] & "-" & [NMIS_AGREEMENT_LOTS].[END_FY] AS [FY's], NMIS_AGREEMENT_LOTS.AKA, NMIS_AGREEMENT_LOTS_1.ID AS [Prev ID], NMIS_AGREEMENT_LOTS.Index AS [Entry Order], NMIS_SPECIES_PRODUCTS.PLNTMSTR_SYMBOL, NMIS_PRODUCTS.CN, Left$(Nz([nmis_agreement_lots].[Category_Code],"B"),1) AS Product_Type, NMIS_SOURCE_LOTS.ID FROM NMIS_PRODUCTS RIGHT JOIN (NMIS_AGREEMENT_LOTS AS NMIS_AGREEMENT_LOTS_1 RIGHT JOIN (NMIS_SOURCE_LOTS RIGHT JOIN (Species_Products_with_SizeSpecString RIGHT JOIN ((NMIS_SPECIES_PRODUCTS RIGHT JOIN (Source_Lot_ID_and_Source_string RIGHT JOIN NMIS_AGREEMENT_LOTS ON Source_Lot_ID_and_Source_string.CN = NMIS_AGREEMENT_LOTS.SOURCE_LOT_CN) ON NMIS_SPECIES_PRODUCTS.CN = NMIS_AGREEMENT_LOTS.SPECIES_PRODUCT_CN) LEFT JOIN NMIS_AGREEMENTS ON NMIS_AGREEMENT_LOTS.CN = NMIS_AGREEMENTS.AGREEMENT_LOT_CN) ON Species_Products_with_SizeSpecString.CN = NMIS_SPECIES_PRODUCTS.CN) ON NMIS_SOURCE_LOTS.CN = NMIS_AGREEMENT_LOTS.SOURCE_LOT_CN) ON NMIS_AGREEMENT_LOTS_1.CN = NMIS_AGREEMENT_LOTS.PREVIOUS_AGREEMENT_LOT_CN) ON NMIS_PRODUCTS.CN = NMIS_SPECIES_PRODUCTS.PRODUCT_CN WHERE (((NMIS_AGREEMENT_LOTS.ID) Like Nz([Forms]![NMIS_AGREEMENT_LOTS]![Like_Agreement_Lots],"*")) AND ((NMIS_AGREEMENTS.CLIENT_ASSOCIATE) Like [Forms]![NMIS_AGREEMENT_LOTS]![Filter_For_Client] & "*" Or (NMIS_AGREEMENTS.CLIENT_ASSOCIATE) Is Null) AND ((NMIS_SPECIES_PRODUCTS.PLNTMSTR_SYMBOL) Like [Forms]![NMIS_AGREEMENT_LOTS]![Filter_for_Species] & "*" Or (NMIS_SPECIES_PRODUCTS.PLNTMSTR_SYMBOL) Is Null) AND ((NMIS_PRODUCTS.CN) Like [Forms]![NMIS_AGREEMENT_LOTS]![Filter_For_Product] & "*" Or (NMIS_PRODUCTS.CN) Is Null) AND ((Left$(Nz([nmis_agreement_lots].[Category_Code],"B"),1)) Like [Forms]![NMIS_AGREEMENT_LOTS]![Filter_for_Product_Type]) AND ((NMIS_SOURCE_LOTS.ID) Like Nz([Forms]![NMIS_AGREEMENT_LOTS]![Like_Source_Lots],"*") Or (NMIS_SOURCE_LOTS.ID) Is Null) AND ((NMIS_AGREEMENT_LOTS.BEGIN_FY) Like [Forms]![NMIS_AGREEMENT_LOTS]![Screen_For_Begin_FY] & "*") AND ((NMIS_AGREEMENT_LOTS.END_FY) Like [Forms]![NMIS_AGREEMENT_LOTS]![Screen_For_End_FY] & "*")) ORDER BY NMIS_AGREEMENT_LOTS.BEGIN_FY DESC , IIf([Forms]![NMIS_AGREEMENT_LOTS]![Sort_By_Entry_Order]=True,IIf([NMIS_AGREEMENT_LOTS].[index]<10,"0","") & IIf([NMIS_AGREEMENT_LOTS].[index]<100,"0","") & IIf([NMIS_AGREEMENT_LOTS].[index]<1000,"0","") & IIf([NMIS_AGREEMENT_LOTS].[index]<10000,"0","") & IIf([NMIS_AGREEMENT_LOTS].[index]<100000,"0","") & IIf([NMIS_AGREEMENT_LOTS].[index]<1000000,"0","") & IIf([NMIS_AGREEMENT_LOTS].[index]<10000000,"0","") & IIf([NMIS_AGREEMENT_LOTS].[index]<100000000,"0","") & [NMIS_AGREEMENT_LOTS].[index],[NMIS_AGREEMENT_LOTS].[id]);

controls.name: Filter_For_Product
controls.RowSource: SELECT NMIS_PRODUCTS.CN, [PRODUCT_DESC] & " (" & [BEGIN_PRODUCT_TYPE] & " " & [END_PRODUCT_TYPE] & ")" AS PRODUCT_DESCRIPTION, NMIS_PRODUCTS.CATEGORY_CODE, NMIS_PRODUCTS.PRODUCT_CLASS, NMIS_PRODUCTS.BEGIN_PRODUCT_TYPE, NMIS_PRODUCTS.END_PRODUCT_TYPE FROM NMIS_PRODUCTS INNER JOIN (NMIS_SPECIES_PRODUCTS INNER JOIN NMIS_AGREEMENT_LOTS ON NMIS_SPECIES_PRODUCTS.CN = NMIS_AGREEMENT_LOTS.SPECIES_PRODUCT_CN) ON NMIS_PRODUCTS.CN = NMIS_SPECIES_PRODUCTS.PRODUCT_CN WHERE (((Left$(nz([NMIS_AGREEMENT_LOTS].[CATEGORY_CODE],"b"),1)) Like [Forms]![NMIS_AGREEMENT_LOTS]![Filter_for_Product_Type]) AND ((NMIS_AGREEMENT_LOTS.BEGIN_FY) Like [Forms]![NMIS_AGREEMENT_LOTS]![Screen_For_Begin_FY] & "*")) GROUP BY NMIS_PRODUCTS.CN, [PRODUCT_DESC] & " (" & [BEGIN_PRODUCT_TYPE] & " " & [END_PRODUCT_TYPE] & ")", NMIS_PRODUCTS.CATEGORY_CODE, NMIS_PRODUCTS.PRODUCT_CLASS, NMIS_PRODUCTS.BEGIN_PRODUCT_TYPE, NMIS_PRODUCTS.END_PRODUCT_TYPE, [PRODUCT_DESC] & " (" & [BEGIN_PRODUCT_TYPE] & " " & [END_PRODUCT_TYPE] & ")", NMIS_PRODUCTS.BEGIN_PRODUCT_TYPE, NMIS_PRODUCTS.END_PRODUCT_TYPE ORDER BY NMIS_PRODUCTS.CATEGORY_CODE, [PRODUCT_DESC] & " (" & [BEGIN_PRODUCT_TYPE] & " " & [END_PRODUCT_TYPE] & ")", NMIS_PRODUCTS.BEGIN_PRODUCT_TYPE, NMIS_PRODUCTS.END_PRODUCT_TYPE;

controls.name: Filter_for_Species
controls.RowSource: SELECT NMIS_SPECIES_PLNTMSTR_SYMBOL_DROPDOWN_QUERY.PLNTMSTR_SYMBOL, NMIS_SPECIES_PLNTMSTR_SYMBOL_DROPDOWN_QUERY.SPECIES_NO, NMIS_SPECIES_PLNTMSTR_SYMBOL_DROPDOWN_QUERY.Scientific_Name, NMIS_SPECIES_PLNTMSTR_SYMBOL_DROPDOWN_QUERY.VERNACULAR FROM ((NMIS_SPECIES_PRODUCTS INNER JOIN NMIS_AGREEMENTS ON NMIS_SPECIES_PRODUCTS.CN = NMIS_AGREEMENTS.SPECIES_PRODUCT_CN) INNER JOIN NMIS_SPECIES_PLNTMSTR_SYMBOL_DROPDOWN_QUERY ON NMIS_SPECIES_PRODUCTS.PLNTMSTR_SYMBOL = NMIS_SPECIES_PLNTMSTR_SYMBOL_DROPDOWN_QUERY.PLNTMSTR_SYMBOL) INNER JOIN NMIS_AGREEMENT_LOTS ON NMIS_AGREEMENTS.AGREEMENT_LOT_CN = NMIS_AGREEMENT_LOTS.CN WHERE (((NMIS_AGREEMENTS.CLIENT_ASSOCIATE) Like [Forms]![NMIS_AGREEMENT_LOTS]![Filter_For_Client] & "*") AND ((NMIS_AGREEMENTS.BEGIN_FY) Like [Forms]![NMIS_AGREEMENT_LOTS]![Screen_For_Begin_FY] & "*") AND ((Left$(nz([nmis_agreement_lots].[Category_Code],"B"),1)) Like [Forms]![NMIS_AGREEMENT_LOTS]![Filter_for_Product_Type] & "*") AND ((NMIS_SPECIES_PRODUCTS.PRODUCT_CN) Like [Forms]![NMIS_AGREEMENT_LOTS]![Filter_For_Product] & "*")) GROUP BY NMIS_SPECIES_PLNTMSTR_SYMBOL_DROPDOWN_QUERY.PLNTMSTR_SYMBOL, NMIS_SPECIES_PLNTMSTR_SYMBOL_DROPDOWN_QUERY.SPECIES_NO, NMIS_SPECIES_PLNTMSTR_SYMBOL_DROPDOWN_QUERY.Scientific_Name, NMIS_SPECIES_PLNTMSTR_SYMBOL_DROPDOWN_QUERY.VERNACULAR, NMIS_SPECIES_PLNTMSTR_SYMBOL_DROPDOWN_QUERY.HIDE HAVING (((NMIS_SPECIES_PLNTMSTR_SYMBOL_DROPDOWN_QUERY.HIDE)=False));
controls.StatusBarText: Double-Click to Clear

controls.name: Filter_For_Client
controls.RowSource: SELECT NMIS_ASSOCIATES.ASSOCIATE, NMIS_ASSOCIATES.ASSOCIATE_NAME FROM (NMIS_ASSOCIATES INNER JOIN NMIS_AGREEMENTS ON (NMIS_ASSOCIATES.ASSOCIATE = NMIS_AGREEMENTS.CLIENT_ASSOCIATE) AND (NMIS_ASSOCIATES.ASSOCIATE = NMIS_AGREEMENTS.CLIENT_ASSOCIATE)) INNER JOIN (NMIS_AGREEMENT_LOTS INNER JOIN NMIS_SPECIES_PRODUCTS ON NMIS_AGREEMENT_LOTS.SPECIES_PRODUCT_CN = NMIS_SPECIES_PRODUCTS.CN) ON NMIS_AGREEMENTS.AGREEMENT_LOT_CN = NMIS_AGREEMENT_LOTS.CN WHERE (((NMIS_SPECIES_PRODUCTS.PLNTMSTR_SYMBOL) Like [Forms]![NMIS_AGREEMENT_LOTS]![Filter_for_Species] & "*") AND ((NMIS_SPECIES_PRODUCTS.PRODUCT_CN) Like [Forms]![NMIS_AGREEMENT_LOTS]![Filter_For_Product] & "*") AND ((NMIS_AGREEMENT_LOTS.BEGIN_FY) Like [Forms]![NMIS_AGREEMENT_LOTS]![Screen_For_Begin_FY] & "*")) GROUP BY NMIS_ASSOCIATES.ASSOCIATE, NMIS_ASSOCIATES.ASSOCIATE_NAME, Left$(nz([nmis_agreement_lots].[Category_Code],"B"),1) HAVING (((Left$(nz([nmis_agreement_lots].[Category_Code],"B"),1)) Like [Forms]![NMIS_AGREEMENT_LOTS]![Filter_for_Product_Type] & "*"));

NMIS_AGREEMENTS.SOURCE_LOT_CN) LEFT JOIN [Species_Product_and _Products] ON NMIS_AGREEMENTS.SPECIES_PRODUCT_CN = [Species_Product_and _Products].CN) LEFT JOIN NMIS_AGREEMENT_LOTS ON NMIS_AGREEMENTS.AGREEMENT_LOT_CN = NMIS_AGREEMENT_LOTS.CN WHERE (((NMIS_AGREEMENT_LOTS.ID) Like nz([Forms]![NMIS_AGREEMENTS]![Like_Agreement_Lots],"*") Or (NMIS_AGREEMENT_LOTS.ID) Is Null) AND ((IIf(IsNull([NMIS_AGREEMENT_LOTS].[CN]),"N","y")) Like IIf([Forms]![NMIS_AGREEMENTS]![No_Agreement_lot],"N","*")) AND ((NMIS_AGREEMENTS.BEGIN_FY) Like [Forms]![NMIS_AGREEMENTS]![Filter_for_FY] & "*") AND ((Left$(nz([Category],"*"),1)) Like [Forms]![NMIS_AGREEMENTS]![Filter_for_Product_Type] & "*") AND ((NMIS_AGREEMENTS.CLIENT_ASSOCIATE) Like [Forms]![NMIS_AGREEMENTS]![Filter_For_Client] & "*") AND & "*" Or ([Species_Product_and _Products].PRODUCT_CN) Is Null) AND ((nz([nmis_agreements].[END_FY],"9999")) Like nz([Forms]![NMIS_AGREEMENTS]![Filter_For_End_FY],"*")) AND (([Species_Product_and _Products].SPECIES_PRODUCT_DESC) Like nz([Forms]![NMIS_AGREEMENTS]![Like_Species_Prod_Desc],"*") Or ([Species_Product_and _Products].SPECIES_PRODUCT_DESC) Is Null)) ORDER BY NMIS_AGREEMENTS.BEGIN_FY DESC , Left$(nz([Category],"*"),1), NMIS_AGREEMENTS.CLIENT_ASSOCIATE, nz([PLNTMSTR_SYMBOL],"No Spec Prod"), [Species_Product_and _Products].Class, Source_Lot_ID_and_Source_string.ID_SOURCE2;

Lot") & "   " & [ID_Sourceb] & " (REQ: " & [AMOUNT_REQUESTED] & ", FY's:" & [NMIS_AGREEMENTS].[BEGIN_FY] & "-" & [NMIS_AGREEMENTS].[End_FY] & ")" AS LOOKUP, NMIS_AGREEMENT_LOTS.ID FROM ((Source_Lot_ID_and_Source_string RIGHT JOIN NMIS_AGREEMENTS ON Source_Lot_ID_and_Source_string.CN = NMIS_AGREEMENTS.SOURCE_LOT_CN) LEFT JOIN [Species_Product_and _Products] ON NMIS_AGREEMENTS.SPECIES_PRODUCT_CN = [Species_Product_and _Products].CN) LEFT JOIN NMIS_AGREEMENT_LOTS ON NMIS_AGREEMENTS.AGREEMENT_LOT_CN = NMIS_AGREEMENT_LOTS.CN WHERE (((NMIS_AGREEMENTS.END_FY) Like [Forms]![NMIS_AGREEMENTS]![Filter_for_End_FY] & "*") AND ((NMIS_AGREEMENTS.BEGIN_FY) Like [Forms]![NMIS_AGREEMENTS]![Filter_for_Begin_FY] & "*") AND ((Left$([Category],1)) Like [Forms]![NMIS_AGREEMENTS]![Filter_for_Product_Type] & "*") AND ((NMIS_AGREEMENTS.CLIENT_ASSOCIATE) Like [Forms]![NMIS_AGREEMENTS]![Filter_For_Client] & "*") AND (([Species_Product_and _Products].PLNTMSTR_SYMBOL) Like [Forms]![NMIS_AGREEMENTS]![Filter_For_Species] & "*") AND (([Species_Product_and _Products].Category) Is Not Null) AND (([Species_Product_and _Products].PRODUCT_CN) Like [Forms]![NMIS_AGREEMENTS]![Filter_For_Product] & "*")) ORDER BY NMIS_AGREEMENTS.BEGIN_FY DESC , Left$([Category],1), NMIS_AGREEMENTS.CLIENT_ASSOCIATE, [Species_Product_and _Products].PLNTMSTR_SYMBOL, [Species_Product_and _Products].Class, Source_Lot_ID_and_Source_string.ID_SOURCE2;

controls.name: Source_Code
controls.RowSource: SELECT NMIS_SOURCE_LOTS.CN, Source_Lot_ID_and_Source_string.SOURCE, NMIS_SOURCE_LOTS.ID, NMIS_SOURCE_LOTS.STORED_FOR_ASSOCIATE AS [Stored For], Round([Sum Of ACTIVITY_UNITS],3) AS Balance, NMIS_SOURCE_LOTS.PLNTMSTR_SYMBOL, [NMIS_SPECIES_GROUP Query].SPECIES_GROUP, NMIS_SOURCE_LOTS.SEED_ZONE, NMIS_SOURCE_LOTS.BREEDING_ZONE FROM (([NMIS_SPECIES_GROUP Query] INNER JOIN NMIS_SOURCE_LOTS ON [NMIS_SPECIES_GROUP Query].PLNTMSTR_SYMBOL = NMIS_SOURCE_LOTS.PLNTMSTR_SYMBOL) INNER JOIN Source_Lot_ID_and_Source_string ON NMIS_SOURCE_LOTS.CN = Source_Lot_ID_and_Source_string.CN) LEFT JOIN [**Seed_Balance_Table] ON NMIS_SOURCE_LOTS.CN = [**Seed_Balance_Table].CN WHERE (((NMIS_SOURCE_LOTS.STORED_FOR_ASSOCIATE) Like [Forms]![NMIS_AGREEMENTS]![Client_Lookup] & "*") AND ((Round([Sum Of ACTIVITY_UNITS],3))>0.0001) AND ((NMIS_SOURCE_LOTS.PLNTMSTR_SYMBOL) Like [Forms]![NMIS_AGREEMENTS]![Species_Lookup] & "*") AND (([NMIS_SPECIES_GROUP Query].SPECIES_GROUP) Like [Forms]![NMIS_AGREEMENTS]![Species_Group] & "*") AND ((NMIS_SOURCE_LOTS.SEED_ZONE) Like [Forms]![NMIS_AGREEMENTS]![Zone_Lookup] & "*")) OR (((NMIS_SOURCE_LOTS.STORED_FOR_ASSOCIATE) Like [Forms]![NMIS_AGREEMENTS]![Client_Lookup] & "*") AND ((Round([Sum Of ACTIVITY_UNITS],3))>0.0001) AND ((NMIS_SOURCE_LOTS.PLNTMSTR_SYMBOL) Like [Forms]![NMIS_AGREEMENTS]![Species_Lookup] & "*") AND (([NMIS_SPECIES_GROUP Query].SPECIES_GROUP) Like [Forms]![NMIS_AGREEMENTS]![Species_Group] & "*") AND ((NMIS_SOURCE_LOTS.BREEDING_ZONE) Like [Forms]![NMIS_AGREEMENTS]![Zone_Lookup] & "*")) ORDER BY Source_Lot_ID_and_Source_string.SOURCE;

controls.RowSource: SELECT NMIS_SPECIES_PRODUCTS.CN, [NMIS_SPECIES_PRODUCTS].[SPECIES_PRODUCT_DESC] & " " & [NMIS_SPECIES_PRODUCTS].[PLNTMSTR_SYMBOL] & " " & [SIZE_SPEC_STRING] & " (" & [BEGIN_PRODUCT_TYPE] & "-" & [END_PRODUCT_TYPE] & ") (" & [BEGIN_SEASON_CODE] & "-" & [END_SEASON_CODE] & ")" & IIf(([NMIS_SPECIES_PRODUCTS].[historical] Or [NMIS_PRODUCTS].[historical])," *HISTORICAL*") AS [Species Product Description], NMIS_PRODUCTS.PRODUCT_DESC, NMIS_PRODUCTS.HISTORICAL, Left$([NMIS_PRODUCTS].[CATEGORY_CODE],1) AS Product_Type FROM NMIS_PRODUCTS INNER JOIN (NMIS_SPECIES_PRODUCTS INNER JOIN Species_Products_with_SizeSpecString ON NMIS_SPECIES_PRODUCTS.CN = Species_Products_with_SizeSpecString.CN) ON NMIS_PRODUCTS.CN = NMIS_SPECIES_PRODUCTS.PRODUCT_CN WHERE (((NMIS_PRODUCTS.HISTORICAL) Like IIf(IsNull([Forms]![NMIS_AGREEMENTS]![SPECIES_PRODUCT_CN]),0,"*")) AND ((Left$([NMIS_PRODUCTS].[CATEGORY_CODE],1)) Like IIf(IsNull([Forms]![NMIS_AGREEMENTS]![SPECIES_PRODUCT_CN]),[Forms]![NMIS_AGREEMENTS]![Filter_for_Product_Type],"*")) AND ((NMIS_SPECIES_PRODUCTS.PLNTMSTR_SYMBOL)=[Forms]![NMIS_AGREEMENTS]![PLNTMSTR_SYMBOL]) AND ((NMIS_SPECIES_PRODUCTS.HISTORICAL) Like IIf(IsNull([Forms]![NMIS_AGREEMENTS]![SPECIES_PRODUCT_CN]),0,"*")) AND ((NMIS_PRODUCTS.CN) Like IIf(IsNull([Forms]![NMIS_AGREEMENTS]![SPECIES_PRODUCT_CN]),[Forms]![NMIS_AGREEMENTS]![Filter_For_Product],"*"))) ORDER BY NMIS_PRODUCTS.CATEGORY_CODE, NMIS_SPECIES_PRODUCTS.PLNTMSTR_SYMBOL & " " & NMIS_SPECIES_PRODUCTS.SPECIES_PRODUCT_DESC & " " & [SIZE_SPEC_STRING] & " " & [BEGIN_SEASON_CODE] & " " & [END_SEASON_CODE];

controls.RowSource: SELECT NMIS_ID_LOCATIONS.CN AS ID_LOCATION_CN, [id] & " " & [nmis_locations].[location] & IIf(Not IsNull([sublot_no]),"(" & [sublot_no] & ")") & " " & [nmis_id_locations].[unit_code] AS ID_LOC, "Ord: " & Left$([nmis_orders].[cn],Len([nmis_orders].[cn])-7) & " For: " & [associate] & " " & [associate_name] AS Client_Code_Name, Left$([CATEGORY_CODE],1) AS Sort, Sum(NMIS_TRANSACTIONS.NUMBER_OF_ACTIVITY_UNITS) AS SumOfNUMBER_OF_ACTIVITY_UNITS FROM NMIS_ASSOCIATES INNER JOIN (((NMIS_TRANSACTIONS INNER JOIN (NMIS_LOCATIONS INNER JOIN NMIS_ID_LOCATIONS ON NMIS_LOCATIONS.CN = NMIS_ID_LOCATIONS.LOCATION_CN) ON NMIS_TRANSACTIONS.ID_LOCATION_CN = NMIS_ID_LOCATIONS.CN) INNER JOIN ((Source_Lot_ID_and_Source_string INNER JOIN NMIS_AGREEMENT_LOTS ON Source_Lot_ID_and_Source_string.CN = NMIS_AGREEMENT_LOTS.SOURCE_LOT_CN) INNER JOIN NMIS_ID_ACTIVITIES ON NMIS_AGREEMENT_LOTS.CN = NMIS_ID_ACTIVITIES.AGREEMENT_LOT_CN) ON NMIS_TRANSACTIONS.ID_ACTIVITY_CN = NMIS_ID_ACTIVITIES.CN) INNER JOIN NMIS_ORDERS ON NMIS_ID_ACTIVITIES.ORDER_CN = NMIS_ORDERS.CN) ON NMIS_ASSOCIATES.ASSOCIATE = NMIS_ORDERS.CLIENT_ASSOCIATE GROUP BY NMIS_ID_LOCATIONS.CN, [id] & " " & [nmis_locations].[location] & IIf(Not IsNull([sublot_no]),"(" & [sublot_no] & ")") & " " & [nmis_id_locations].[unit_code], "Ord: " & Left$([nmis_orders].[cn],Len([nmis_orders].[cn])-7) & " For: " & [associate] & " " & [associate_name], Left$([CATEGORY_CODE],1), NMIS_LOCATIONS.LOCATION, NMIS_ID_LOCATIONS.SUBLOT_NO, NMIS_ID_LOCATIONS.UNIT_CODE, Source_Lot_ID_and_Source_string.ID_SOURCE2, NMIS_AGREEMENT_LOTS.BEGIN_FY, Left$(nz([CATEGORY_CODE]," "),1), NMIS_AGREEMENT_LOTS.ID, NMIS_LOCATIONS.LOCATION_TYPE HAVING (((Sum(NMIS_TRANSACTIONS.NUMBER_OF_ACTIVITY_UNITS))>0) AND ((NMIS_LOCATIONS.LOCATION_TYPE)="cooler")) ORDER BY [id] & " " & [nmis_locations].[location] & IIf(Not IsNull([sublot_no]),"(" & [sublot_no] & ")") & " " & [nmis_id_locations].[unit_code], NMIS_AGREEMENT_LOTS.BEGIN_FY DESC , Left$(nz([CATEGORY_CODE]," "),1), NMIS_AGREEMENT_LOTS.ID;

IsNull([NMIS_CONTACTS].[First_name]),", ") & [NMIS_CONTACTS].[FIRST_name] & IIf([NMIS_CONTACTS].[Historical]," (Historic)") AS Name, NMIS_ORDERS.ACTIVITY_CODE, NMIS_ORDERS.CLIENT_ASSOCIATE, NMIS_CLIENT_MGMT_CODES.CLIENT_ASSOCIATE FROM (NMIS_PRODUCTS INNER JOIN NMIS_PRODUCT_TYPES ON NMIS_PRODUCTS.END_PRODUCT_TYPE = NMIS_PRODUCT_TYPES.PRODUCT_TYPE) INNER JOIN ((NMIS_SPECIES_PRODUCTS INNER JOIN (NMIS_AGREEMENTS INNER JOIN ((NMIS_ORDERS RIGHT JOIN (Source_Lot_ID_and_Source_string INNER JOIN NMIS_AGREEMENT_LOTS ON Source_Lot_ID_and_Source_string.CN = NMIS_AGREEMENT_LOTS.SOURCE_LOT_CN) ON NMIS_ORDERS.AGREEMENT_LOT_CN = NMIS_AGREEMENT_LOTS.CN) LEFT JOIN NMIS_CONTACTS ON NMIS_ORDERS.CONTACT_CN = NMIS_CONTACTS.CN) ON NMIS_AGREEMENTS.AGREEMENT_LOT_CN = NMIS_AGREEMENT_LOTS.CN) ON NMIS_SPECIES_PRODUCTS.CN = NMIS_AGREEMENT_LOTS.SPECIES_PRODUCT_CN) LEFT JOIN NMIS_CLIENT_MGMT_CODES ON NMIS_ORDERS.CN = NMIS_CLIENT_MGMT_CODES.ORDER_CN) ON NMIS_PRODUCTS.CN = NMIS_SPECIES_PRODUCTS.PRODUCT_CN WHERE (((Left$([NMIS_AGREEMENT_LOTS].[CATEGORY_CODE],1) & [Product_Group]) Like [Forms]![NMIS_ORDER_BILL_ADJUSTMENTS]![Product_Group]) AND ((NMIS_ORDERS.FISCAL_YEAR)=[Forms]![Switchboard]![FY_For_Reports]) AND ((NMIS_ORDERS.CLIENT_ASSOCIATE) Like [Forms]![NMIS_ORDER_BILL_ADJUSTMENTS]![Like_Client] & "*") AND ((NMIS_ORDERS.CONTACT_CN) Like [Forms]![NMIS_ORDER_BILL_ADJUSTMENTS]![Contact_CN] & "*")) GROUP BY NMIS_AGREEMENT_LOTS.CN, NMIS_AGREEMENT_LOTS.ID, Source_Lot_ID_and_Source_string.ID_SOURCE2, NMIS_ORDERS.FISCAL_YEAR, [NMIS_CONTACTS].[LAST_NAME] & IIf(Not IsNull([NMIS_CONTACTS].[First_name]),", ") & [NMIS_CONTACTS].[FIRST_name] & IIf([NMIS_CONTACTS].[Historical]," (Historic)"), NMIS_ORDERS.ACTIVITY_CODE, NMIS_ORDERS.CLIENT_ASSOCIATE, NMIS_CLIENT_MGMT_CODES.CLIENT_ASSOCIATE, NMIS_CLIENT_MGMT_CODES.CLIENT_ASSOCIATE HAVING (((NMIS_CLIENT_MGMT_CODES.CLIENT_ASSOCIATE) Like [Forms]![NMIS_ORDER_BILL_ADJUSTMENTS]![Like JobcodeClient] & "*")) ORDER BY NMIS_AGREEMENT_LOTS.ID;

NMIS_PRODUCT_TYPES.PRODUCT_TYPE = NMIS_PRODUCTS.END_PRODUCT_TYPE) INNER JOIN (NMIS_ORDERS_SIZE_SPEC_STRING INNER JOIN (NMIS_SPECIES_PRODUCTS INNER JOIN (NMIS_ASSOCIATES RIGHT JOIN (NMIS_AGREEMENT_LOTS INNER JOIN NMIS_ORDERS ON NMIS_AGREEMENT_LOTS.CN = NMIS_ORDERS.AGREEMENT_LOT_CN) ON NMIS_ASSOCIATES.ASSOCIATE = NMIS_ORDERS.CLIENT_ASSOCIATE) ON NMIS_SPECIES_PRODUCTS.CN = NMIS_AGREEMENT_LOTS.SPECIES_PRODUCT_CN) ON NMIS_ORDERS_SIZE_SPEC_STRING.CN = NMIS_ORDERS.CN) ON NMIS_PRODUCTS.CN = NMIS_SPECIES_PRODUCTS.PRODUCT_CN WHERE (((NMIS_ORDERS.FISCAL_YEAR) Like controls.RowSource: SELECT NMIS_ORDERS.CN, IIf([Forms]![NMIS_SHIPPING_TICKET subform]![View_by]=1,Left$([NMIS_ORDERS].[CN],Len([NMIS_ORDERS].[CN])-7) & "/" & [ID],[ID] & "/" & Left$([NMIS_ORDERS].[CN],Len([NMIS_ORDERS].[CN])-7)) AS [Order], NMIS_ORDERS.CLIENT_ASSOCIATE AS Client, NMIS_ORDERS.ACTIVITY_CODE AS [Act Code], Round([Order_Amt],3) & " M" AS [Order Amt], Sum(Round([NO_CONTAINERS]*[DENSITY]/[UNIT_MULTIPLIER],3)) AS [Bal M], NMIS_ORDERS.FISCAL_YEAR AS fy FROM (NMIS_ORDERS INNER JOIN NMIS_AGREEMENT_LOTS ON NMIS_ORDERS.AGREEMENT_LOT_CN = NMIS_AGREEMENT_LOTS.CN) INNER JOIN [*NMIS_ORDER_LOT_BALANCES Table] ON NMIS_ORDERS.CN = [*NMIS_ORDER_LOT_BALANCES Table].CN WHERE (((NMIS_ORDERS.CLIENT_ASSOCIATE) Like IIf(IsNull([order_cn]),[Forms]![NMIS_SHIPPING_TICKET subform]![NMIS_SHIPPING_ID_ACTIVITIES subform].[Form]![Like_Client] & "*","*")) AND ((NMIS_ORDERS.FISCAL_YEAR) Like IIf(IsNull([Forms]![NMIS_SHIPPING_TICKET subform]![NMIS_SHIPPING_ID_ACTIVITIES subform].[Form]![ORDER_CN]),[Forms]![NMIS_SHIPPING_TICKET subform]![view_fy] & "*","*"))) GROUP BY NMIS_ORDERS.CN, NMIS_ORDERS.CLIENT_ASSOCIATE, NMIS_ORDERS.ACTIVITY_CODE, Round([Order_Amt],3) & " M", NMIS_ORDERS.FISCAL_YEAR, IIf([Forms]![NMIS_SHIPPING_TICKET subform]![View_by]=1,Left$([NMIS_ORDERS].[CN],Len([NMIS_ORDERS].[CN])-7) & "/ " & [ID],[ID] & "/ " & Left$([NMIS_ORDERS].[CN],Len([NMIS_ORDERS].[CN])-7)), NMIS_ORDERS.FISCAL_YEAR, NMIS_ORDERS.CN, NMIS_AGREEMENT_LOTS.ID HAVING (((IIf(Sum(Round([NO_CONTAINERS]*[DENSITY]/[UNIT_MULTIPLIER],3))>0,"n","y")) Like IIf(IsNull([Forms]![NMIS_SHIPPING_TICKET subform]![NMIS_SHIPPING_ID_ACTIVITIES subform].[Form]![ORDER_CN]),IIf([Forms]![NMIS_SHIPPING_TICKET subform]![Hide_Zero_Bal_Trans],"n","*"),"*"))) ORDER BY NMIS_ORDERS.FISCAL_YEAR DESC , IIf([Forms]![NMIS_SHIPPING_TICKET subform]![View_by]=1,Left$([NMIS_ORDERS].[CN],Len([NMIS_ORDERS].[CN])-7) & "/ " & [ID],[ID] & "/ " & Left$([NMIS_ORDERS].[CN],Len([NMIS_ORDERS].[CN])-7)), NMIS_ORDERS.FISCAL_YEAR DESC , controls.RowSource: SELECT NMIS_TICKETS.TKT_NO, IIf(Not ([Forms]![NMIS_SHIPPING_TICKET subform]![By_TSO]),[TKT_NO] & " (FY" & Right$([FY],2) & ")",[EXT_DOC_REF]) AS [Ticket #/FY], IIf([Forms]![NMIS_SHIPPING_TICKET subform]![By_TSO],[TKT_NO] & " (FY" & Right$([FY],2) & ")",[EXT_DOC_REF] & IIf(Not IsNull([EXT_DOC_REF])," " & [GBL_PCT] & "%")) AS TSO, [CHARGE_PER_TICKET]*1 AS [TSO $], "(" & [DELIVERED_TO_ASSOCIATE] & ") " & [ASSOCIATE_NAME] AS [Delivered To], [DELIVERED_BY_ASSOCIATE] & " " AS [Del by], [DESIRED_DATE] & " " AS [Date], NMIS_TICKETS.NOTE FROM NMIS_ASSOCIATES RIGHT JOIN NMIS_TICKETS ON NMIS_ASSOCIATES.ASSOCIATE = NMIS_TICKETS.DELIVERED_TO_ASSOCIATE WHERE (((NMIS_TICKETS.FY) Like [View_FY] & "*") AND ((NMIS_TICKETS.TICKET_TYPE)="P") AND ((NMIS_TICKETS.DELIVERED_TO_ASSOCIATE) Like [Forms]![NMIS_SHIPPING_TICKET subform]![Like_Client] & "*")) ORDER BY NMIS_TICKETS.FY DESC , NMIS_TICKETS.DESIRED_DATE DESC , IIf(Not ([Forms]![NMIS_SHIPPING_TICKET subform]![By_TSO]),Val(Right$([TKT_NO],Len([TKT_NO])-2)),[EXT_DOC_REF]) DESC , Val(Right$([TKT_NO],Len([TKT_NO])-2)) DESC;

controls.name: SPECIES_PRODUCT_Lookup
controls.RowSource: SELECT NMIS_SPECIES_PRODUCTS.CN, IIf([Forms]![NMIS_SPECIES_PRODUCTS Form]![View_By_Scientific_Name]=False,[nmis_species].[Vernacular],[Scientific_Name]) & " (" & [NMIS_SPECIES_PRODUCTS].[PLNTMSTR_SYMBOL] & ") " & [NMIS_SPECIES_PRODUCTS].[SPECIES_PRODUCT_DESC] & " " & [SIZE_SPEC_STRING] & " " & [nmis_species_products].[BEGIN_SEASON_CODE] & " " & [nmis_species_products].[END_SEASON_CODE] & IIf([nmis_species_products].[historical]," (Historical)") AS [Species Product Description], [PRODUCT_DESC] & " (" & [BEGIN_PRODUCT_TYPE] & " " & [END_PRODUCT_TYPE] & ")" AS PRODUCT_DESCRIPTION, IIf([diverse],"No","Yes") AS Trad, [nmis_species_products].[TOTAL_NUMBER_OF_FY]+0 AS [FY's], [SOWING_GROUP] & " " AS [Sow Ord], [TRANSPLANT_GROUP] & "" AS [Trans Ord] FROM (NMIS_PRODUCT_TYPES INNER JOIN NMIS_PRODUCTS ON NMIS_PRODUCT_TYPES.PRODUCT_TYPE = NMIS_PRODUCTS.END_PRODUCT_TYPE) INNER JOIN ([*Species_Products_Currently_Active_in_Grow_Containers] RIGHT JOIN (NMIS_SPECIES INNER JOIN (NMIS_SPECIES_SCIENTIFIC_NAME_COMBINE_Query INNER JOIN (NMIS_SPECIES_PRODUCTS INNER JOIN Species_Products_with_SizeSpecString ON NMIS_SPECIES_PRODUCTS.CN = Species_Products_with_SizeSpecString.CN) ON NMIS_SPECIES_SCIENTIFIC_NAME_COMBINE_Query.PLNTMSTR_SYMBOL = NMIS_SPECIES_PRODUCTS.PLNTMSTR_SYMBOL) ON (NMIS_SPECIES.PLNTMSTR_SYMBOL = NMIS_SPECIES_PRODUCTS.PLNTMSTR_SYMBOL) AND (NMIS_SPECIES.PLNTMSTR_SYMBOL = NMIS_SPECIES_PRODUCTS.PLNTMSTR_SYMBOL)) ON [*Species_Products_Currently_Active_in_Grow_Containers].SPECIES_PRODUCT_CN = NMIS_SPECIES_PRODUCTS.CN) ON NMIS_PRODUCTS.CN = NMIS_SPECIES_PRODUCTS.PRODUCT_CN WHERE (((NMIS_SPECIES_PRODUCTS.PLNTMSTR_SYMBOL) Like [Forms]![NMIS_SPECIES_PRODUCTS Form]![Filter_for_Species] & "*") AND ((NMIS_PRODUCTS.CN) Like [Forms]![NMIS_SPECIES_PRODUCTS Form]![PRODUCT_Lookup] & "*" And (NMIS_PRODUCTS.CN) Like [Forms]![NMIS_SPECIES_PRODUCTS Form]![Filter_For_Product] & "*") AND ((Left$([NMIS_PRODUCTS].[CATEGORY_CODE],1)) Like [Forms]![NMIS_SPECIES_PRODUCTS Form]![Filter_for_Product_Type]) AND ((IIf([Forms]![NMIS_SPECIES_PRODUCTS Form]![Current_Crop_Only],[SPECIES_PRODUCT_CN],"all")) Is Not Null) AND ((NMIS_SPECIES_PRODUCTS.HISTORICAL) Like IIf([Forms]![NMIS_SPECIES_PRODUCTS Form]![Hide_Historical],0,"*"))) GROUP BY NMIS_SPECIES_PRODUCTS.CN, IIf([Forms]![NMIS_SPECIES_PRODUCTS Form]![View_By_Scientific_Name]=False,[nmis_species].[Vernacular],[Scientific_Name]) & " (" & [NMIS_SPECIES_PRODUCTS].[PLNTMSTR_SYMBOL] & ") " & [NMIS_SPECIES_PRODUCTS].[SPECIES_PRODUCT_DESC] & " " & [SIZE_SPEC_STRING] & " " & [nmis_species_products].[BEGIN_SEASON_CODE] & " " & [nmis_species_products].[END_SEASON_CODE] & IIf([nmis_species_products].[historical]," (Historical)"), [PRODUCT_DESC] & " Agreement_Lot_Current_Age_Class.BorCforCycle FROM (NMIS_PRODUCTS INNER JOIN Product_String ON NMIS_PRODUCTS.CN = Product_String.CN) INNER JOIN (((Agreement_Lot_Total_Containers_Grow RIGHT JOIN (NMIS_SPECIES INNER JOIN (NMIS_SPECIES_PRODUCTS_BEGIN_CONTAINER INNER JOIN (NMIS_SPECIES_PRODUCTS INNER JOIN NMIS_AGREEMENT_LOTS ON NMIS_SPECIES_PRODUCTS.CN = NMIS_AGREEMENT_LOTS.SPECIES_PRODUCT_CN) ON NMIS_SPECIES_PRODUCTS_BEGIN_CONTAINER.SPECIES_PRODUCT_CN = NMIS_AGREEMENT_LOTS.SPECIES_PRODUCT_CN) ON (NMIS_SPECIES.PLNTMSTR_SYMBOL = NMIS_SPECIES_PRODUCTS.PLNTMSTR_SYMBOL) AND (NMIS_SPECIES.PLNTMSTR_SYMBOL = NMIS_SPECIES_PRODUCTS.PLNTMSTR_SYMBOL)) ON Agreement_Lot_Total_Containers_Grow.Agreement_Lot_CN = NMIS_AGREEMENT_LOTS.CN) INNER JOIN Agreement_Lot_Current_Age_Class ON NMIS_AGREEMENT_LOTS.CN = Agreement_Lot_Current_Age_Class.CN) INNER JOIN Agreement_Lots_Currently_Active_in_Grow_Containers ON NMIS_AGREEMENT_LOTS.CN = Agreement_Lots_Currently_Active_in_Grow_Containers.CN) ON NMIS_PRODUCTS.CN = NMIS_SPECIES_PRODUCTS.PRODUCT_CN WHERE (((NMIS_AGREEMENT_LOTS.END_FY) Like [Forms]![Plant_Inventory_Worksheets Form]![End_FY] & "*") AND ((NMIS_AGREEMENT_LOTS.BEGIN_FY) Like [Forms]![Plant_Inventory_Worksheets Form]![Begin_FY] & "*") AND ((NMIS_AGREEMENT_LOTS.CATEGORY_CODE) Is Not Null) AND ((NMIS_SPECIES_PRODUCTS.PLNTMSTR_SYMBOL) Like Nz([Forms]![Plant_Inventory_Worksheets Form]![Plntmstr_Symbol],"*")) AND ((NMIS_SPECIES_PRODUCTS.SPECIES_PRODUCT_DESC)<>"Seed")) GROUP BY Agreement_Lot_Current_Age_Class.Age_Class, Agreement_Lot_Current_Age_Class.BorCforCycle, Agreement_Lot_Current_Age_Class.BorCforCycle HAVING (((Agreement_Lot_Current_Age_Class.BorCforCycle) In items.name: Client_Bill_Income_Dist_Client_Jobcode_Subform
items.caption: Client Bill Income Dist subreport
items.recordSource: SELECT [CLIENT] & IIf([JOB_CODE]<>[CLIENT]," " & UCase([JOB_CODE])) AS JC, CLIENT_BILL_INCOME_DIST1.CLIENT, CLIENT_BILL_INCOME_DIST1.JOB_CODE, nz([MGMT_CODE],"Undefined") AS MC, Sum(Round(IIf([OVERRIDE]="AT",1,[UNITS])*[CHARGE_PER_UNIT]*([PERCENT_OF_CHARGE]/100),2)) AS INCOME FROM CLIENT_BILL_INCOME_DIST1 LEFT JOIN NMIS_PRODUCT_MGMT_CODES_QUERY ON CLIENT_BILL_INCOME_DIST1.PMC_LINK = NMIS_PRODUCT_MGMT_CODES_QUERY.PMC_LINK WHERE (((IIf(IsNull([Forms]![Client_Bill_Menu]![Contact_CN]),"ALL",[Contact_CN])) Like IIf(IsNull([Forms]![Client_Bill_Menu]![Contact_CN]),"ALL",[Forms]![Client_Bill_Menu]![Contact_CN])) AND ((CLIENT_BILL_INCOME_DIST1.BILL_CODE)<>"HOLD")) GROUP BY [CLIENT] & IIf([JOB_CODE]<>[CLIENT]," " & UCase([JOB_CODE])), CLIENT_BILL_INCOME_DIST1.CLIENT, CLIENT_BILL_INCOME_DIST1.JOB_CODE, nz([MGMT_CODE],"Undefined") ORDER BY nz([MGMT_CODE],"Undefined");

items.name: Client_Bill_Income_Dist_Summary_Subform
items.caption: Client Bill Income Dist subreport
items.recordSource: SELECT nz([MGMT_CODE],"Undefined") AS MC, Sum(Round(IIf([OVERRIDE]="AT",1,[UNITS])*[CHARGE_PER_UNIT]*([PERCENT_OF_CHARGE]/100),2)) AS INCOME FROM CLIENT_BILL_INCOME_DIST1 LEFT JOIN NMIS_PRODUCT_MGMT_CODES_QUERY ON CLIENT_BILL_INCOME_DIST1.PMC_LINK = NMIS_PRODUCT_MGMT_CODES_QUERY.PMC_LINK WHERE (((IIf(IsNull([Forms]![Client_Bill_Menu]![Contact_CN]),"ALL",[Contact_CN])) Like IIf(IsNull([Forms]![Client_Bill_Menu]![Contact_CN]),"ALL",[Forms]![Client_Bill_Menu]![Contact_CN])) AND ((CLIENT_BILL_INCOME_DIST1.CLIENT) Like [Forms]![Client_Bill_Menu]![Like_Client] & "*") AND ((CLIENT_BILL_INCOME_DIST1.BILL_CODE)<>"HOLD")) GROUP BY nz([MGMT_CODE],"Undefined") ORDER BY nz([MGMT_CODE],"Undefined");

items.recordSource: SELECT NMIS_LOCATIONS.LOCATION, NMIS_AGREEMENT_LOTS.ID, Abs([Begin_Counter]-[End_Counter]) AS Ft_In_Lot, NMIS_ID_LOCATIONS.BEGIN_INDEX, NMIS_ID_LOCATIONS.END_INDEX, NMIS_ID_LOCATIONS.DIST_FROM_BED_BEG, Left$([location],1) AS Field, NMIS_LOCATIONS.INDEX_MAX, NMIS_SOURCE_LOTS.PLNTMSTR_SYMBOL FROM NMIS_SOURCE_LOTS INNER JOIN ((NMIS_LOCATIONS INNER JOIN NMIS_ID_LOCATIONS ON NMIS_LOCATIONS.CN = NMIS_ID_LOCATIONS.LOCATION_CN) INNER JOIN NMIS_AGREEMENT_LOTS ON NMIS_ID_LOCATIONS.AGREEMENT_LOT_CN = NMIS_AGREEMENT_LOTS.CN) ON NMIS_SOURCE_LOTS.CN = NMIS_AGREEMENT_LOTS.SOURCE_LOT_CN GROUP BY NMIS_LOCATIONS.LOCATION, NMIS_AGREEMENT_LOTS.ID, Abs([Begin_Counter]-[End_Counter]), NMIS_ID_LOCATIONS.BEGIN_INDEX, NMIS_ID_LOCATIONS.END_INDEX, NMIS_ID_LOCATIONS.DIST_FROM_BED_BEG, Left$([location],1), NMIS_LOCATIONS.INDEX_MAX, NMIS_SOURCE_LOTS.PLNTMSTR_SYMBOL, NMIS_LOCATIONS.LOCATION_TYPE HAVING (((NMIS_LOCATIONS.LOCATION) Like [Forms]![Field_Map Form]![Field] & "*") AND ((NMIS_LOCATIONS.LOCATION_TYPE)="Field")) ORDER BY NMIS_LOCATIONS.LOCATION;

items.caption: Associates Contacts Phone Numbers
items.recordSource: SELECT NMIS_ASSOCIATES.ASSOCIATE, NMIS_ASSOCIATES.ASSOCIATE_NAME, NMIS_CONTACTS_CURRENT.CONTACT_NAME_UPPER, NMIS_PHONE_NUMBERS.PHONE_NUMBER, NMIS_PHONE_TYPES.PHONE_TYPE, NMIS_CONTACTS_CURRENT.CONTACT_DESC, NMIS_CONTACTS_CURRENT.EMAIL_ADDR FROM ((NMIS_ASSOCIATES LEFT JOIN NMIS_CONTACT_LINKS ON NMIS_ASSOCIATES.ASSOCIATE = NMIS_CONTACT_LINKS.LINK_ASSOCIATE) LEFT JOIN NMIS_CONTACTS_CURRENT ON NMIS_CONTACT_LINKS.CONTACT_CN = NMIS_CONTACTS_CURRENT.CN) LEFT JOIN (NMIS_PHONE_TYPES RIGHT JOIN NMIS_PHONE_NUMBERS ON NMIS_PHONE_TYPES.CN = NMIS_PHONE_NUMBERS.PHONE_TYPE_CN) ON NMIS_CONTACTS_CURRENT.CN = NMIS_PHONE_NUMBERS.CONTACT_CN WHERE (((NMIS_ASSOCIATES.ASSOCIATE) Like "0601*" Or (NMIS_ASSOCIATES.ASSOCIATE) Like "0607*" Or (NMIS_ASSOCIATES.ASSOCIATE) Like "0602*" Or (NMIS_ASSOCIATES.ASSOCIATE) Like "0620*")) GROUP BY NMIS_ASSOCIATES.ASSOCIATE, NMIS_ASSOCIATES.ASSOCIATE_NAME, NMIS_CONTACTS_CURRENT.CONTACT_NAME_UPPER, NMIS_PHONE_NUMBERS.PHONE_NUMBER, NMIS_PHONE_TYPES.PHONE_TYPE, NMIS_CONTACTS_CURRENT.CONTACT_DESC, NMIS_CONTACTS_CURRENT.EMAIL_ADDR;

items.recordSource: SELECT NMIS_AGREEMENTS.AGREEMENT_LOT_CN, NMIS_AGREEMENTS.SOURCE_LOT_CN, [NMIS_CLIENT_MGMT_CODES].[CLIENT_ASSOCIATE] & " " & [MGMT_CODE] & " " & Round((([MGMT_CODE_PCT]/100)*[PCT_of_Total]),0) & "%" AS PAYEE_MGMT_CODE_N_PCT, [FIRST_NAME] & " " & [LAST_NAME] AS Contact_Name FROM ([Agreement_PCT_of_Total Query] INNER JOIN (NMIS_CLIENT_MGMT_CODES INNER JOIN NMIS_AGREEMENTS ON NMIS_CLIENT_MGMT_CODES.AGREEMENT_CN = NMIS_AGREEMENTS.CN) ON [Agreement_PCT_of_Total Query].CN = NMIS_AGREEMENTS.CN) LEFT JOIN NMIS_CONTACTS ON NMIS_AGREEMENTS.CONTACT_CN = NMIS_CONTACTS.CN GROUP BY NMIS_AGREEMENTS.AGREEMENT_LOT_CN, NMIS_AGREEMENTS.SOURCE_LOT_CN, [NMIS_CLIENT_MGMT_CODES].[CLIENT_ASSOCIATE] & " " & [MGMT_CODE] & " " & Round((([MGMT_CODE_PCT]/100)*[PCT_of_Total]),0) & "%", [FIRST_NAME] & " " & [LAST_NAME];

items.caption: NMIS_SOURCE_Inventory
items.recordSource: SELECT NMIS_SOURCE_LOTS.ID, Source_Lot_ID_and_Source_string.SOURCE, [Seed_Balance Query].[Sum Of ACTIVITY_UNITS] FROM NMIS_SPECIES INNER JOIN (([Seed_Balance Query] INNER JOIN NMIS_SOURCE_LOTS ON [Seed_Balance Query].SOURCE_LOT_CN = NMIS_SOURCE_LOTS.CN) INNER JOIN Source_Lot_ID_and_Source_string ON NMIS_SOURCE_LOTS.CN = Source_Lot_ID_and_Source_string.CN) ON NMIS_SPECIES.PLNTMSTR_SYMBOL = NMIS_SOURCE_LOTS.PLNTMSTR_SYMBOL WHERE ((([Seed_Balance Query].[Sum Of ACTIVITY_UNITS])>0.0001) AND ((NMIS_SOURCE_LOTS.PLNTMSTR_SYMBOL) Like [Species Code (Blank for all)] & "*") AND ((NMIS_SOURCE_LOTS.STORED_FOR_ASSOCIATE) Like [Like Client (blank for all)] & "*") AND ((NMIS_SOURCE_LOTS.STORED_AT_ASSOCIATE)=[Forms]![Switchboard]![NMIS_ACCESS_SET_USER_NURSERY subform].[Form]![Nursery_Associate_Code]) AND ((NMIS_SPECIES.DIVERSE)=IIf([Traditional (Y or N) ]="N",-1,0))) ORDER BY NMIS_SOURCE_LOTS.ID;

items.recordSource: SELECT NMIS_PROPAGULE_HARVEST_PRIORITIES.HARVEST_PRIORITY, NMIS_AGREEMENT_LOTS.ID, NMIS_PROPAGULE_HARVEST_PRIORITIES.NOTE, NMIS_PROPAGULE_HARVEST_PRIORITIES.HARVEST_DATE, NMIS_PROPAGULE_HARVEST_PRIORITIES.AGREEMENT_LOT_CN, NMIS_SPECIES.SPECIES_GROUP FROM NMIS_SPECIES INNER JOIN (NMIS_SPECIES_PRODUCTS INNER JOIN (NMIS_PROPAGULE_HARVEST_PRIORITIES INNER JOIN NMIS_AGREEMENT_LOTS ON NMIS_PROPAGULE_HARVEST_PRIORITIES.AGREEMENT_LOT_CN = NMIS_AGREEMENT_LOTS.CN) ON NMIS_SPECIES_PRODUCTS.CN = NMIS_AGREEMENT_LOTS.SPECIES_PRODUCT_CN) ON (NMIS_SPECIES.PLNTMSTR_SYMBOL = NMIS_SPECIES_PRODUCTS.PLNTMSTR_SYMBOL) AND (NMIS_SPECIES.PLNTMSTR_SYMBOL = NMIS_SPECIES_PRODUCTS.PLNTMSTR_SYMBOL) WHERE (((NMIS_PROPAGULE_HARVEST_PRIORITIES.HARVEST_DATE) Is Not Null) AND ((NMIS_PROPAGULE_HARVEST_PRIORITIES.HARVEST_FY)=[Forms]![Propagule_Harvest_Priorties]![Like_Harvest_FY]));

items.recordSource: SELECT NMIS_PROPAGULE_HARVEST_PRIORITIES.HARVEST_PRIORITY, NMIS_AGREEMENT_LOTS.ID, NMIS_PROPAGULE_HARVEST_PRIORITIES.NOTE, NMIS_PROPAGULE_HARVEST_PRIORITIES.AGREEMENT_LOT_CN, NMIS_SPECIES.SPECIES_GROUP, [HARVEST_DATE] & " - " & [HARVEST_METHOD] AS HD FROM NMIS_SPECIES INNER JOIN (NMIS_SPECIES_PRODUCTS INNER JOIN (NMIS_PROPAGULE_HARVEST_PRIORITIES INNER JOIN NMIS_AGREEMENT_LOTS ON NMIS_PROPAGULE_HARVEST_PRIORITIES.AGREEMENT_LOT_CN = NMIS_AGREEMENT_LOTS.CN) ON NMIS_SPECIES_PRODUCTS.CN = NMIS_AGREEMENT_LOTS.SPECIES_PRODUCT_CN) ON (NMIS_SPECIES.PLNTMSTR_SYMBOL = NMIS_SPECIES_PRODUCTS.PLNTMSTR_SYMBOL) AND (NMIS_SPECIES.PLNTMSTR_SYMBOL = NMIS_SPECIES_PRODUCTS.PLNTMSTR_SYMBOL) WHERE (((NMIS_PROPAGULE_HARVEST_PRIORITIES.HARVEST_FY)=[Forms]![Propagule_Harvest_Priorties]![Like_Harvest_FY]) AND ((NMIS_PROPAGULE_HARVEST_PRIORITIES.HARVEST_DATE) Is Not Null));

Private Sub END_INDEX_Exit(Cancel As Integer)
    Dim VarX As Variant

    VarY = DLookup("[index_max]", "NMIS_LOCATIONS", "LOCATION = [LOCMOD]")
    
    Last_Est_Units = Est_Units
    If Not IsNull(AGREEMENT_LOT_CN) Then
        If Not IsNull(END_INDEX) Then
            If IsNull(INDEX_INCREMENT) Then
                If VarX = "FIELD" Then
                    INDEX_INCREMENT = Forms![Switchboard]![NMIS_ACCESS_SET_USER_NURSERY subform].Form![Field_Index_Increment_Default]
                Else
                    INDEX_INCREMENT = 1
                End If
            End If
            Beg_Counter_Last = BEGIN_COUNTER
            Beg_Index_Last = BEGIN_INDEX
            End_Index_Last = END_INDEX
            If Nz(SOW_DIRECTION, 1) = 1 Then
                If Val(Nz(BEGIN_INDEX, 0)) > Val(Nz(END_INDEX, 0)) Then
                    temp = BEGIN_INDEX
                    BEGIN_INDEX = END_INDEX
                    END_INDEX = temp
                    'SOWN_BACKWARDS = True
                    'Map_Backwards = True
                Else
                    'SOWN_BACKWARDS = False
                    'Map_Backwards = False
                End If
            Else
                If Val(Nz(END_INDEX, 0)) > Val(Nz(BEGIN_INDEX, 0)) Then
                    temp = BEGIN_INDEX
                    BEGIN_INDEX = END_INDEX
                    END_INDEX = temp
                    'SOWN_BACKWARDS = True
                    'Map_Backwards = True
                Else
                    'SOWN_BACKWARDS = False
                    'Map_Backwards = False
                End If
            End If
            If END_INDEX = 999 Then
                END_INDEX = Round(VarY / Nz(INDEX_INCREMENT, 1), 1)
            End If
            If Est_Counter Then
                END_COUNTER = END_INDEX * [INDEX_INCREMENT]
                BEGIN_COUNTER = BEGIN_INDEX * INDEX_INCREMENT
            End If
            'Beg_Index_Last = BEGIN_INDEX
            'End_Index_Last = END_INDEX
        
        End If
        Location_Key2 = [Locmod] & [SUBLOT_NO] & [Riser_Begin] & [Riser_End]

Private Sub Process_Into_NMIS_Click()
On Error GoTo Err_Process_Into_NMIS_Click

    If Not Processed_Into_NMIS Then
        DoCmd.Requery
        DoCmd.SetWarnings False
        DoCmd.OpenQuery "Husky_mpro_update_hloc_table"
        DoCmd.OpenQuery "Husky_mpro_Dump_Index_Drop"
        DoCmd.OpenQuery "Husky_mpro_Dump_Index_CO_Drop"
        DoCmd.OpenQuery "Husky_mpro_Dump_Hloc_Index_Drop"
        DoCmd.OpenQuery "Husky_mpro_Dump_Index_Create"
        DoCmd.OpenQuery "Husky_mpro_Dump_Index_CO_Create"
        DoCmd.OpenQuery "Husky_mpro_Dump_Lots"
        DoCmd.OpenQuery "Husky_mpro_Dump_CO_Lots"
        DoCmd.OpenQuery "Husky_mpro_Dump_Ctl_Create"
        DoCmd.OpenQuery "Husky_mpro_ID_Activities_Insert"
        DoCmd.OpenQuery "Husky_mpro_Dump_CO_Ctl_Create"
        DoCmd.OpenQuery "Husky_mpro_Dump_Hloc_Index_Create"
        DoCmd.OpenQuery "Husky_mpro_Dump_HLoc_Lots"
        DoCmd.OpenQuery "Husky_mpro_ID_Locations_Insert"
                    
        If Activity_Code = "LOCCHG" Then
            'If the activity is Location Changes (LOCCHG) then Zero out previous location info
            DoCmd.OpenQuery "Husky_mpro_Transactions_previous_densities_MT"
            DoCmd.OpenQuery "Husky_mpro_Transactions_previous_zero_for_location_change"
            DoCmd.OpenQuery "Husky_mpro_Transactions_Insert_Loc_Change"
            DoCmd.OpenQuery "Transactions_Current_Balance_Gross_n_Net_mt"
            DoCmd.OpenQuery "Husky_mpro_ID_Activities_locchg_Update"
        Else
            'If Nursery Owned packed for transplant, Zero out packing balances
            DoCmd.OpenQuery "Husky_mpro_transactions_prev_zero"
            DoCmd.OpenQuery "Husky_mpro_Transactions_Insert"
            'If Client Owned from a previous agreement zero out the previous agreement balances
            DoCmd.OpenQuery "Husky_mpro_ID_Activities_CO_zero_Insert"
            DoCmd.OpenQuery "Husky_mpro_transactions_xplt_prev_zero"
            'If Holdover from a previous agreement zero out the previous agreement balances
            DoCmd.OpenQuery "Husky_mpro_ID_Activities_Holdover_zero_Insert"
            DoCmd.OpenQuery "Husky_mpro_transactions_Holdover_prev_zero"
        End If

        DoCmd.SetWarnings True
        Processed_Into_NMIS = True

    If Not IsNull([BALANCE_EFFECT]) And Not IsNull([ACTIVITY_UNITS]) Then
    stBalance_Effect = [BALANCE_EFFECT]
    Select Case stBalance_Effect

Private Sub Calculate_Click()
On Error GoTo Err_Calculate_Click
    Dim ASF As Double
    Dim PLS As Double
    Dim NF As Double
    Dim REQ As Double
    
    REQ = (Forms!NMIS_AGREEMENT_LOTS!TOTAL_REQUEST * 1000)
    PLS = (Forms!NMIS_AGREEMENT_LOTS!GROSS_SOURCE_PER_UNIT * (Forms!NMIS_AGREEMENT_LOTS!SOURCE_GERM_PCT * 0.01) * (Forms!NMIS_AGREEMENT_LOTS!SOURCE_PURITY_PCT * 0.01))
    ASF = (Forms!NMIS_AGREEMENT_LOTS!HARVEST_ASF_ADJUSTMENT * 0.01)
    NF = (Forms!NMIS_AGREEMENT_LOTS!HARVEST_FACTOR_1 * 0.01) * (Forms!NMIS_AGREEMENT_LOTS!HARVEST_FACTOR_2 * 0.01) * (Forms!NMIS_AGREEMENT_LOTS!HARVEST_FACTOR_3 * 0.01) * (Forms!NMIS_AGREEMENT_LOTS!HARVEST_FACTOR_4 * 0.01)
    
    Forms!NMIS_AGREEMENT_LOTS!SOURCE_REQUIRED = (REQ / (PLS * NF * ASF))
    DoCmd.RunCommand acCmdRefreshPage
    
Exit_Calculate_Click:
    Exit Sub

    Resume Exit_Calculate_Click

    REQ = (Forms!NMIS_AGREEMENT_LOTS!TOTAL_REQUEST * 1000)
    PLS = (Forms!NMIS_AGREEMENT_LOTS!GROSS_SOURCE_PER_UNIT * _
          (Forms!NMIS_AGREEMENT_LOTS!SOURCE_GERM_PCT * 0.01) * _
          (Forms!NMIS_AGREEMENT_LOTS!SOURCE_PURITY_PCT * 0.01))
    ASF = (Forms!NMIS_AGREEMENT_LOTS!HARVEST_ASF_ADJUSTMENT * 0.01)
    HARVEST_FACTOR = (Forms!NMIS_AGREEMENT_LOTS!HARVEST_FACTOR_1 * 0.01) * _
                     (Forms!NMIS_AGREEMENT_LOTS!HARVEST_FACTOR_2 * 0.01) * _
                     (Forms!NMIS_AGREEMENT_LOTS!HARVEST_FACTOR_3 * 0.01) * _
                     (Forms!NMIS_AGREEMENT_LOTS!HARVEST_FACTOR_4 * 0.01)
    Source_Req = (REQ / (PLS * HARVEST_FACTOR * ASF))
    
    Forms!NMIS_AGREEMENT_LOTS!SOURCE_REQUIRED = Source_Req

Private Sub Calculate_Containers_Required_Button_Click()
On Error GoTo Err_Calculate_Containers_Required_Button_Click

Dim ASF As Double
    Dim Source_Req As Double
    Dim PLS As Double
    Dim CF1 As Double
    Dim CF2 As Double
    Dim CF3 As Double
    Dim TARGET_DENSITY As Double
    Dim Cells_Per_Container As Double
    Dim CONTAINER_ASF As Double
    Dim CONTAINER_FACTOR As Double


'Calculate Grow Containers
    Source_Req = Forms!NMIS_AGREEMENT_LOTS!SOURCE_REQUIRED
    PLS = (Forms!NMIS_AGREEMENT_LOTS!GROSS_SOURCE_PER_UNIT * _
          (Forms!NMIS_AGREEMENT_LOTS!SOURCE_GERM_PCT * 0.01) * _
          (Forms!NMIS_AGREEMENT_LOTS!SOURCE_PURITY_PCT * 0.01))
    CF1 = [NMIS_FACTORS subform]![CONTAINER_FACTOR_1] / 100
    CF2 = [NMIS_FACTORS subform]![CONTAINER_FACTOR_2] / 100
    CF3 = [NMIS_FACTORS subform]![CONTAINER_FACTOR_3] / 100
    TARGET_DENSITY = [NMIS_FACTORS subform]![DESIRED_DENSITY]
    Cells_Per_Container = [NMIS_AGREE_NEW_UNITS subform]![Cells_Per_Container]
    CONTAINER_ASF = (Forms!NMIS_AGREEMENT_LOTS!CONTAINER_ASF_ADJUSTMENT * 0.01)
    CONTAINER_FACTOR = CF1 * CF2 * CF3
    
    Forms!NMIS_AGREEMENT_LOTS!EST_CONTAINERS_REQUIRED = _
            ((Source_Req * PLS) / CONTAINER_FACTOR / (TARGET_DENSITY * Cells_Per_Container) * _
              CONTAINER_ASF)

Private Sub Form_Open(Cancel As Integer)
' Minimize the database window and initialize the form.

    ' Move to the switchboard page that is marked as the default.
    Me.Filter = "[ItemNumber] = 0 AND [Argument] = 'Default' "
    Me.FilterOn = True
    
End Sub

Private Sub Form_Current()
' Update the caption and fill in the list of options.

    Me.Caption = Nz(Me![ItemText], "")
    FillOptions
    
End Sub

Private Sub FillOptions()
' Fill in the options for this switchboard page.

    ' The number of buttons on the form.
    Const conNumButtons = 8
    
    Dim con As Object
    Dim rs As Object
    Dim stSql As String
    Dim intOption As Integer
    
    ' Set the focus to the first button on the form,
    ' and then hide all of the buttons on the form
    ' but the first.  You can't hide the field with the focus.
    Me![Option1].SetFocus
    For intOption = 2 To conNumButtons
        Me("Option" & intOption).Visible = False
        Me("OptionLabel" & intOption).Visible = False
    Next intOption
    
    ' Open the table of Switchboard Items, and find
    ' the first item for this Switchboard Page.
    Set con = Application.CurrentProject.Connection
    stSql = "SELECT * FROM [Switchboard Items]"
    stSql = stSql & " WHERE [ItemNumber] > 0 AND [SwitchboardID]=" & Me![SwitchboardID]
    stSql = stSql & " ORDER BY [ItemNumber];"
    Set rs = CreateObject("ADODB.Recordset")
    rs.Open stSql, con, 1   ' 1 = adOpenKeyset
    
    ' If there are no options for this Switchboard Page,
    ' display a message.  Otherwise, fill the page with the items.
    If (rs.EOF) Then
        Me![OptionLabel1].Caption = "There are no items for this switchboard page"
    Else
        While (Not (rs.EOF))
            Me("Option" & rs![ItemNumber]).Visible = True
            Me("OptionLabel" & rs![ItemNumber]).Visible = True
            Me("OptionLabel" & rs![ItemNumber]).Caption = rs![ItemText]
            rs.MoveNext
        Wend
    End If

    ' Close the recordset and the database.
    rs.Close
    Set rs = Nothing
    Set con = Nothing

End Sub

Private Function HandleButtonClick(intBtn As Integer)
' This function is called when a button is clicked.
' intBtn indicates which button was clicked.

    ' Constants for the commands that can be executed.
    Const conCmdGotoSwitchboard = 1
    Const conCmdOpenFormAdd = 2
    Const conCmdOpenFormBrowse = 3
    Const conCmdOpenReport = 4
    Const conCmdCustomizeSwitchboard = 5
    Const conCmdExitApplication = 6
    Const conCmdRunMacro = 7
    Const conCmdRunCode = 8
    Const conCmdOpenPage = 9

    ' An error that is special cased.
    Const conErrDoCmdCancelled = 2501
    
    Dim con As Object
    Dim rs As Object
    Dim stSql As String

On Error GoTo HandleButtonClick_Err

    ' Find the item in the Switchboard Items table
    ' that corresponds to the button that was clicked.
    Set con = Application.CurrentProject.Connection
    Set rs = CreateObject("ADODB.Recordset")
    stSql = "SELECT * FROM [Switchboard Items] "
    stSql = stSql & "WHERE [SwitchboardID]=" & Me![SwitchboardID] & " AND [ItemNumber]=" & intBtn
    rs.Open stSql, con, 1    ' 1 = adOpenKeyset
    
    ' If no item matches, report the error and exit the function.
    If (rs.EOF) Then
        MsgBox "There was an error reading the Switchboard Items table."
        rs.Close
        Set rs = Nothing
        Set con = Nothing
        Exit Function
    End If
    
    Select Case rs![Command]
        
        ' Go to another switchboard.
        Case conCmdGotoSwitchboard
            Me.Filter = "[ItemNumber] = 0 AND [SwitchboardID]=" & rs![Argument]
            
        ' Open a form in Add mode.
        Case conCmdOpenFormAdd
            DoCmd.OpenForm rs![Argument], , , , acAdd

        ' Open a form.
        Case conCmdOpenFormBrowse
            DoCmd.OpenForm rs![Argument]

        ' Open a report.
        Case conCmdOpenReport
            DoCmd.OpenReport rs![Argument], acPreview

        ' Customize the Switchboard.
        Case conCmdCustomizeSwitchboard
            ' Handle the case where the Switchboard Manager
            ' is not installed (e.g. Minimal Install).
            On Error Resume Next
            Application.Run "ACWZMAIN.sbm_Entry"
            If (Err <> 0) Then MsgBox "Command not available."
            On Error GoTo 0
            ' Update the form.
            Me.Filter = "[ItemNumber] = 0 AND [Argument] = 'Default' "
            Me.Caption = Nz(Me![ItemText], "")
            FillOptions

        ' Exit the application.
        Case conCmdExitApplication
            CloseCurrentDatabase

        ' Run a macro.
        Case conCmdRunMacro
            DoCmd.RunMacro rs![Argument]

        ' Run code.
        Case conCmdRunCode
            Application.Run rs![Argument]

        ' Open a Data Access Page
        Case conCmdOpenPage
            DoCmd.OpenDataAccessPage rs![Argument]

        ' Any other command is unrecognized.
        Case Else
            MsgBox "Unknown option."
    
    End Select

    ' Close the recordset and the database.
    rs.Close
    
HandleButtonClick_Exit:
On Error Resume Next
    Set rs = Nothing
    Set con = Nothing
    Exit Function

HandleButtonClick_Err:
    ' If the action was cancelled by the user for
    ' some reason, don't display an error message.
    ' Instead, resume on the next line.
    If (Err = conErrDoCmdCancelled) Then
        Resume Next
    Else
        MsgBox "There was an error executing the command.", vbCritical
        Resume HandleButtonClick_Exit
    End If
    
End Function

Private Sub Calculate_Click()
'Calculate source required

On Error GoTo Err_Calculate_Click
    Dim ASF As Double
    Dim PLS As Double
    Dim NF As Double
    Dim REQ As Double
    Dim HARVEST_FACTOR As Double
    Dim Source_Req As Double
    Dim Source_Reg2 As Double
    Dim Will_Grow As Double
    Dim Shortage As Double
    Dim CF1 As Double
    Dim CF2 As Double
    Dim CF3 As Double
    Dim TARGET_DENSITY As Double
    'Dim Cells_Per_Container As Double
    Dim CONTAINER_ASF As Double
    Dim CONTAINER_FACTOR As Double

'Propagule
    If CATEGORY_CODE = "NSP" Then
    'Calculate Grow Containers
        EST_CONTAINERS_REQUIRED = TOTAL_REQUEST * Propagule_BF_per_Acre
    'Calculate Source Needs
        MsgBox "NMIS does not currently calculate source needs. To be implemented at a later time."
    Else
        
'Non-Propagule
    'Calculate source needs
    If Pure_Live_Seed > 0 Then
    REQ = (Forms!NMIS_AGREEMENT_LOTS!TOTAL_REQUEST * 1000)
    PLS = (Forms!NMIS_AGREEMENT_LOTS!GROSS_SOURCE_PER_UNIT * _
          (Forms!NMIS_AGREEMENT_LOTS!SOURCE_GERM_PCT / 100) * _
          (Forms!NMIS_AGREEMENT_LOTS!SOURCE_PURITY_PCT / 100))
    ASF = (Forms!NMIS_AGREEMENT_LOTS!HARVEST_ASF_ADJUSTMENT / 100)
    HARVEST_FACTOR = (Forms!NMIS_AGREEMENT_LOTS!HF1 / 100) * _
                     (Forms!NMIS_AGREEMENT_LOTS!HF2 / 100) * _
                     (Forms!NMIS_AGREEMENT_LOTS!HF3 / 100) * _
                     (Forms!NMIS_AGREEMENT_LOTS!HF4 / 100)
    Source_Req = Round((REQ / (PLS * HARVEST_FACTOR * ASF)), 3)

    If Source_Req <= Forms!NMIS_AGREEMENT_LOTS![Seed_Balance Query subform]![Sum Of ACTIVITY_UNITS] Then
            Forms!NMIS_AGREEMENT_LOTS!SOURCE_REQUIRED = Source_Req
        Else
            If Forms!NMIS_AGREEMENT_LOTS![Seed_Balance Query subform]![Sum Of ACTIVITY_UNITS] >= 0 Then
                If Forms!NMIS_AGREEMENT_LOTS![Seed_Balance Query subform]![Sum Of ACTIVITY_UNITS] < 0.0001 Then
                    MsgBox "This is a Zero Balance Lot!"
                    Forms!NMIS_AGREEMENT_LOTS!SOURCE_REQUIRED = Source_Req
                Else
                    Forms!NMIS_AGREEMENT_LOTS!SOURCE_REQUIRED = Round(Forms!NMIS_AGREEMENT_LOTS![Seed_Balance Query subform]![Sum Of ACTIVITY_UNITS], 3)
                    MsgBox "Insufficient Seed. Check Calculated for Request Adjustment"
                End If
            Else
                Forms!NMIS_AGREEMENT_LOTS!SOURCE_REQUIRED = Source_Req
                MsgBox "Undetermined amount of source material."
            End If
    End If
    Else
        MsgBox "No test data entered to calculate source. Calculating containers only"
    End If
    
    'Calculate Grow Containers
    If [DESIRED_DENSITY] > 0 Then
            Source_Req2 = Forms!NMIS_AGREEMENT_LOTS!SOURCE_REQUIRED
            CF1 = [CF1A] / 100
            CF2 = [CF2A] / 100
            CF3 = [CF3A] / 100
            TARGET_DENSITY = [DESIRED_DENSITY]
            'Cells_Per_Container = _
                '[NMIS_SPECIES_PRODUCTS_BEGIN_CONTAINER subform1]![Cells_Per_Container]
            CONTAINER_ASF = (Forms!NMIS_AGREEMENT_LOTS!CONTAINER_ASF_ADJUSTMENT / 100)
            CONTAINER_FACTOR = CF1 * CF2 * CF3
            
            If [Type_of_Container] = "SB" Then
                Forms!NMIS_AGREEMENT_LOTS!EST_CONTAINERS_REQUIRED = _
                ((Source_Req2 * PLS) * CONTAINER_FACTOR / (TARGET_DENSITY * Cells_Per_Container) * _
                  CONTAINER_ASF)
            Else 'For Containers
                Forms!NMIS_AGREEMENT_LOTS!EST_CONTAINERS_REQUIRED = _
                ((Calculated_Gross * 1000) * 1 / (TARGET_DENSITY * Cells_Per_Container) * _
                  CONTAINER_FACTOR) + 0.35
            End If
        Else
            MsgBox "No target density has been entered. Est Containers will not be calculated."
     End If
     End If
     
Exit_Calculate_Click:
    Exit Sub

Err_Calculate_Click:
    MsgBox Err.DESCRIPTION
    Resume Exit_Calculate_Click
    
End Sub

Private Sub CONTAINER_ASF_ADJUSTMENT_Exit(Cancel As Integer)

   If [DESIRED_DENSITY] > 0 Then
            Source_Req2 = Forms!NMIS_AGREEMENT_LOTS!SOURCE_REQUIRED
            CF1 = [CF1A] / 100
            CF2 = [CF2A] / 100
            CF3 = [CF3A] / 100
            PLS = (Forms!NMIS_AGREEMENT_LOTS!GROSS_SOURCE_PER_UNIT * _

Private Sub SOURCE_REQUIRED_Exit(Cancel As Integer)
'Relock Source_Required
    
    If [SOURCE_REQUIRED].Locked = False Then
        [SOURCE_REQUIRED].Locked = True
    End If

'Recalculate the container needs for bareroot if the source amount is changed

   If [Type_of_Container] = "SB" Then
  
    Dim ASF As Double
    Dim Source_Req2 As Double
    Dim PLS As Double
    Dim CF1 As Double
    Dim CF2 As Double
    Dim CF3 As Double
    Dim TARGET_DENSITY As Double
    Dim Cells_Per_Container As Double
    Dim CONTAINER_ASF As Double
    Dim CONTAINER_FACTOR As Double


'Calculate Grow Containers
    If IsNull(SOURCE_REQUIRED) Then
       MsgBox "No Source Required Entered"
    Else
    If [DESIRED_DENSITY] > 0 Then
        Source_Req2 = Forms!NMIS_AGREEMENT_LOTS!SOURCE_REQUIRED
        If Not IsNull(Forms!NMIS_AGREEMENT_LOTS!GROSS_SOURCE_PER_UNIT) Then
            PLS = (Forms!NMIS_AGREEMENT_LOTS!GROSS_SOURCE_PER_UNIT * _
                (Forms!NMIS_AGREEMENT_LOTS!SOURCE_GERM_PCT / 100) * _
                (Forms!NMIS_AGREEMENT_LOTS!SOURCE_PURITY_PCT / 100))
        End If
        CF1 = [CF1A] / 100
        CF2 = [CF2A] / 100
        CF3 = [CF3A] / 100
        TARGET_DENSITY = [DESIRED_DENSITY]
        Cells_Per_Container = _
            [NMIS_SPECIES_PRODUCTS_BEGIN_CONTAINER subform1]![Cells_Per_Container]
        CONTAINER_ASF = (Forms!NMIS_AGREEMENT_LOTS!CONTAINER_ASF_ADJUSTMENT / 100)
        CONTAINER_FACTOR = CF1 * CF2 * CF3
    
        Forms!NMIS_AGREEMENT_LOTS!EST_CONTAINERS_REQUIRED = _
                ((Source_Req2 * PLS) * CONTAINER_FACTOR / (TARGET_DENSITY * Cells_Per_Container) * _
                  CONTAINER_ASF)
    Else
        MsgBox "No target density has been entered. Est Containers will not be calculated."
    End If
    End If
   End If
    
End Sub

vba.Form_Switchboard:
Option Compare Database

Private Sub Form_Open(Cancel As Integer)
' Minimize the database window and initialize the form.

    ' Move to the switchboard page that is marked as the default.
    Me.Filter = "[ItemNumber] = 0 AND [Argument] = 'Default' "
    Me.FilterOn = True
    
    ' Set Current_User_Name
    Current_User_Name = CurrentUserName
   
End Sub

Private Sub Form_Current()
' Update the caption and fill in the list of options.

    Me.Caption = Nz(Me![ItemText], "")
    FillOptions
    
End Sub

Private Sub FillOptions()
' Fill in the options for this switchboard page.

    ' The number of buttons on the form.
    Const conNumButtons = 8
    
    Dim con As Object
    Dim rs As Object
    Dim stSql As String
    Dim intOption As Integer
    
    ' Set the focus to the first button on the form,
    ' and then hide all of the buttons on the form
    ' but the first.  You can't hide the field with the focus.
    Me![Option1].SetFocus
    For intOption = 2 To conNumButtons
        Me("Option" & intOption).Visible = False
        Me("OptionLabel" & intOption).Visible = False
    Next intOption
    
    ' Open the table of Switchboard Items, and find
    ' the first item for this Switchboard Page.
    Set con = Application.CurrentProject.Connection
    stSql = "SELECT * FROM [Switchboard Items]"
    stSql = stSql & " WHERE [ItemNumber] > 0 AND [SwitchboardID]=" & Me![SwitchboardID]
    stSql = stSql & " ORDER BY [ItemNumber];"
    Set rs = CreateObject("ADODB.Recordset")
    rs.Open stSql, con, 1   ' 1 = adOpenKeyset
    
    ' If there are no options for this Switchboard Page,
    ' display a message.  Otherwise, fill the page with the items.
    If (rs.EOF) Then
        Me![OptionLabel1].Caption = "There are no items for this switchboard page"
    Else
        While (Not (rs.EOF))
            Me("Option" & rs![ItemNumber]).Visible = True
            Me("OptionLabel" & rs![ItemNumber]).Visible = True
            Me("OptionLabel" & rs![ItemNumber]).Caption = rs![ItemText]
            rs.MoveNext
        Wend
    End If

    ' Close the recordset and the database.
    rs.Close
    Set rs = Nothing
    Set con = Nothing

End Sub

Private Function HandleButtonClick(intBtn As Integer)
' This function is called when a button is clicked.
' intBtn indicates which button was clicked.

    ' Constants for the commands that can be executed.
    Const conCmdGotoSwitchboard = 1
    Const conCmdOpenFormAdd = 2
    Const conCmdOpenFormBrowse = 3
    Const conCmdOpenReport = 4
    Const conCmdCustomizeSwitchboard = 5
    Const conCmdExitApplication = 6
    Const conCmdRunMacro = 7
    Const conCmdRunCode = 8
    Const conCmdOpenPage = 9

    ' An error that is special cased.
    Const conErrDoCmdCancelled = 2501
    
    Dim con As Object
    Dim rs As Object
    Dim stSql As String

On Error GoTo HandleButtonClick_Err

    ' Find the item in the Switchboard Items table
    ' that corresponds to the button that was clicked.
    Set con = Application.CurrentProject.Connection
    Set rs = CreateObject("ADODB.Recordset")
    stSql = "SELECT * FROM [Switchboard Items] "
    stSql = stSql & "WHERE [SwitchboardID]=" & Me![SwitchboardID] & " AND [ItemNumber]=" & intBtn
    rs.Open stSql, con, 1    ' 1 = adOpenKeyset
    
    ' If no item matches, report the error and exit the function.
    If (rs.EOF) Then
        MsgBox "There was an error reading the Switchboard Items table."
        rs.Close
        Set rs = Nothing
        Set con = Nothing
        Exit Function
    End If
    
    Select Case rs![Command]
        
        ' Go to another switchboard.
        Case conCmdGotoSwitchboard
            Me.Filter = "[ItemNumber] = 0 AND [SwitchboardID]=" & rs![Argument]
            
        ' Open a form in Add mode.
        Case conCmdOpenFormAdd
            DoCmd.OpenForm rs![Argument], , , , acAdd

        ' Open a form.
        Case conCmdOpenFormBrowse
            DoCmd.OpenForm rs![Argument]

        ' Open a report.
        Case conCmdOpenReport
            DoCmd.OpenReport rs![Argument], acPreview

        ' Customize the Switchboard.
        Case conCmdCustomizeSwitchboard
            ' Handle the case where the Switchboard Manager
            ' is not installed (e.g. Minimal Install).
            On Error Resume Next
            Application.Run "ACWZMAIN.sbm_Entry"
            If (Err <> 0) Then MsgBox "Command not available."
            On Error GoTo 0
            ' Update the form.
            Me.Filter = "[ItemNumber] = 0 AND [Argument] = 'Default' "
            Me.Caption = Nz(Me![ItemText], "")
            FillOptions

        ' Exit the application.
        Case conCmdExitApplication
            CloseCurrentDatabase

        ' Run a macro.
        Case conCmdRunMacro
            DoCmd.RunMacro rs![Argument]

        ' Run code.
        Case conCmdRunCode
            Application.Run rs![Argument]

        ' Open a Data Access Page
        Case conCmdOpenPage
            DoCmd.OpenDataAccessPage rs![Argument]

        ' Any other command is unrecognized.
        Case Else
            MsgBox "Unknown option."
    
    End Select

    ' Close the recordset and the database.
    rs.Close
    
HandleButtonClick_Exit:
On Error Resume Next
    Set rs = Nothing
    Set con = Nothing
    Exit Function

HandleButtonClick_Err:
    ' If the action was cancelled by the user for
    ' some reason, don't display an error message.
    ' Instead, resume on the next line.
    If (Err = conErrDoCmdCancelled) Then
        Resume Next
    Else
        MsgBox "There was an error executing the command.", vbCritical
        Resume HandleButtonClick_Exit
    End If
    
End Function

Private Sub Generate_Source_Code_Click()
On Error GoTo Err_Generate_Source_Code_Click

    Dim stSpecies_Code As String
    Dim stSOURCE_Code As String
    Dim stSource_Code_Type As String
    Dim stZone As String
    Dim stHUC As String
    
    If IsNull(SOURCE_CODE) Then
        If Forms![NMIS_SOURCE_LOTS_INPUT]![SOURCE_CODE_TYPE Subform]![SOURCE_CODE_TYPE] > "" Then
                stSource_Code_Type = Forms![NMIS_SOURCE_LOTS_INPUT]![SOURCE_CODE_TYPE Subform]![SOURCE_CODE_TYPE]
              Else
                stSource_Code_Type = "UNS"
        End If

        Select Case stSource_Code_Type
    
            Case Is = "BLM"
                stSOURCE_Code = [Plntmstr_Symbol] & "-" & _
                Mid([STORED_FOR_ASSOCIATE], 3, 2) & "-" & _
                [SEED_ZONE] & "-" & _
                [ORIGIN_ELEVATION] & "-" & _
                Right(Nz([CROP_YEAR], [DATE_COLLECTED]), 2) & " " & _
                [CERT_CODE]
        
            Case Is = "R1"
                stSOURCE_Code = Forms![NMIS_SOURCE_LOTS_INPUT]![NMIS_SPECIES_NO subform]![SPECIES_ABBREVIATION] & "-" & _
                Mid([STORED_FOR_ASSOCIATE], 3, 2) & "-" & _
                [ORIGIN_ELEVATION] & "-" & _
                [ID]
            
            Case Is = "R2"
                stSOURCE_Code = _
                [Plntmstr_Symbol] & "-" & _
                Mid([STORED_FOR_ASSOCIATE], 3, 2) & "-" & _
                Mid([STORED_FOR_ASSOCIATE], 5, 2) & "-" & _
                [SEED_ZONE] & "-" & _
                [ORIGIN_ELEVATION] & "-" & _
                Right(Nz([CROP_YEAR], [DATE_COLLECTED]), 2)
            
            Case Is = "R4"
                MsgBox "Source Code is not used by Region 04"
                GoTo Exit_Generate_Source_Code_Click
        
            Case Is = "R5"
                If Forms![NMIS_SOURCE_LOTS_INPUT]![NMIS_SPECIES_NO subform]![SPECIES_NO] <> "" Then
                    stSpecies_Code = Forms![NMIS_SOURCE_LOTS_INPUT]![NMIS_SPECIES_NO subform]![SPECIES_NO]
                Else
                    stSpecies_Code = Forms![NMIS_SOURCE_LOTS_INPUT]![NMIS_SPECIES_NO subform]![Plntmstr_Symbol]
                End If
                If COMBINED Then
                    stCombined_code = "="
                Else
                    stCombined_code = "-"
                End If
            
                stSOURCE_Code = _
                stSpecies_Code & "-" & _
                [SEED_ZONE] & "." & _
                [ORIGIN_ELEVATION] & "-" & _
                Mid([STORED_FOR_ASSOCIATE], 3, 2) & "-" & _
                Mid([STORED_FOR_ASSOCIATE], 5, 2) & "-" & _
                [COLLECT_METHOD] & "-" & _
                [GENETIC_BASE] & _
                stCombined_code & _
                Right(Nz([CROP_YEAR], [DATE_COLLECTED]), 2)
            
            Case Is = "R6"
                If [BREEDING_ZONE] > "" Then
                    stZone = [BREEDING_ZONE] & "-"
                Else
                    stZone = [SEED_ZONE] & "-" & Mid([STORED_FOR_ASSOCIATE], 5, 2)
                End If
                If [HUC] > "" Then
                stHUC = [HUC] & "-"
                Else
                    stHUC = ""
                End If
            
                stSOURCE_Code = [Plntmstr_Symbol] & "-" & _
                Mid([STORED_FOR_ASSOCIATE], 3, 2) & "-" & _
                stZone & _
                [COLLECT_METHOD] & "-" & _
                [ORIGIN_ELEVATION] & "-" & _
                stHUC & _
                Right(Nz([CROP_YEAR], [DATE_COLLECTED]), 2) & " " & _
                [CERT_CODE]
                
            Case Is = "R6d"
                If Forms![NMIS_SOURCE_LOTS_INPUT]![NMIS_SPECIES_NO subform]![SPECIES_NO] <> "" Then
                    stSpecies_Code = Forms![NMIS_SOURCE_LOTS_INPUT]![NMIS_SPECIES_NO subform]![SPECIES_NO]
                Else
                    stSpecies_Code = Forms![NMIS_SOURCE_LOTS_INPUT]![NMIS_SPECIES_NO subform]![Plntmstr_Symbol]
                End If
                
                stSOURCE_Code = _
                [ACCESSION] & "-" & _
                Right(Nz([CROP_YEAR], [DATE_COLLECTED]), 2) & "-" & _
                stSpecies_Code & "-" & _
                [TREE]
            
                'stSOURCE_Code = _
                'stSpecies_Code & "-" & _
                '[ACCESSION] & "-" & _
                '[TREE] & "-" & _
                'Right(Nz([CROP_YEAR], [DATE_COLLECTED]), 2)
            
            Case Is = "R9"
                stSOURCE_Code = _
                [Plntmstr_Symbol] & "-" & _
                Mid([STORED_FOR_ASSOCIATE], 3, 2) & "-" & _
                [SEED_ZONE] & "-" & _
                Right(Nz([CROP_YEAR], [DATE_COLLECTED]), 2)
            
            Case Is = "UNS"
            stSOURCE_Code = "Source Code type not specified"
        
            Case Else
            stSOURCE_Code = "Source Code Type Unknown"
        
            End Select
    
        [SOURCE_CODE] = stSOURCE_Code
    
    End If

Exit_Generate_Source_Code_Click:
    Exit Sub

Err_Generate_Source_Code_Click:
    MsgBox Err.DESCRIPTION
    Resume Exit_Generate_Source_Code_Click
    
End Sub

    PLS = (Forms!NMIS_AGREEMENT_LOTS!GROSS_SOURCE_PER_UNIT * _
          (Forms!NMIS_AGREEMENT_LOTS!SOURCE_GERM_PCT / 100) * _
          (Forms!NMIS_AGREEMENT_LOTS!SOURCE_PURITY_PCT / 100))
    ASF = (Forms!NMIS_AGREEMENT_LOTS!HARVEST_ASF_ADJUSTMENT / 100)
    HARVEST_FACTOR = (Forms!NMIS_AGREEMENT_LOTS!HARVEST_FACTOR_1 / 100) * _
                     (Forms!NMIS_AGREEMENT_LOTS!HARVEST_FACTOR_2 / 100) * _
                     (Forms!NMIS_AGREEMENT_LOTS!HARVEST_FACTOR_3 / 100) * _
                     (Forms!NMIS_AGREEMENT_LOTS!HARVEST_FACTOR_4 / 100)
    Source_Req = (REQ / (PLS * HARVEST_FACTOR * ASF))
    
    Forms!NMIS_AGREEMENT_LOTS!SOURCE_REQUIRED = Source_Req

    Exit Sub

    MsgBox Err.DESCRIPTION
    Resume Exit_Calculate_Click

Private Sub Calculate_Containers_Required_Button_Click()
On Error GoTo Err_Calculate_Containers_Required_Button_Click

Dim ASF As Double
    Dim Source_Req As Double
    Dim PLS As Double
    Dim CF1 As Double
    Dim CF2 As Double
    Dim CF3 As Double
    Dim TARGET_DENSITY As Double
    Dim Cells_Per_Container As Double
    Dim CONTAINER_ASF As Double
    Dim CONTAINER_FACTOR As Double


'Calculate Grow Containers
    Source_Req = Forms!NMIS_AGREEMENT_LOTS!SOURCE_REQUIRED
    PLS = (Forms!NMIS_AGREEMENT_LOTS!GROSS_SOURCE_PER_UNIT * _
          (Forms!NMIS_AGREEMENT_LOTS!SOURCE_GERM_PCT / 100) * _
          (Forms!NMIS_AGREEMENT_LOTS!SOURCE_PURITY_PCT / 100))
    CF1 = [NMIS_FACTORS subform]![CONTAINER_FACTOR_1] / 100
    CF2 = [NMIS_FACTORS subform]![CONTAINER_FACTOR_2] / 100
    CF3 = [NMIS_FACTORS subform]![CONTAINER_FACTOR_3] / 100
    TARGET_DENSITY = [NMIS_FACTORS subform]![DESIRED_DENSITY]
    Cells_Per_Container = [NMIS_AGREE_UNITS subform]![Cells_Per_Container]
    CONTAINER_ASF = (Forms!NMIS_AGREEMENT_LOTS!CONTAINER_ASF_ADJUSTMENT / 100)
    CONTAINER_FACTOR = CF1 * CF2 * CF3
    
    Forms!NMIS_AGREEMENT_LOTS!EST_CONTAINERS_REQUIRED = _
            ((Source_Req * PLS) * CONTAINER_FACTOR / (TARGET_DENSITY * Cells_Per_Container) * _
              CONTAINER_ASF)
    

Exit_Calculate_Containers_Required_Butto:
    Exit Sub

Private Sub Calculate_Gross_Click()

    If IsNull(Forms!NMIS_PRODUCT_INVENTORIES![NMIS_PRODUCT_INVENTORY_SAMPLES subform1].Form!Sum_of_Sample_Count) Then
        MsgBox "You Must enter Sample Counts First!"
    Else
        Gross_Per_Unit_calculated = Nz(Round((Forms!NMIS_PRODUCT_INVENTORIES![NMIS_PRODUCT_INVENTORY_SAMPLES subform1].Form!Sum_of_Sample_Count / _
            Forms!NMIS_PRODUCT_INVENTORIES![NMIS_PRODUCT_INVENTORY_SAMPLES subform1].Form!Max_Sample_No) * [Plot_Area], 3), 0)
        If Forms!NMIS_PRODUCT_INVENTORIES![Agreement_Lot_Total_Containers subform].Form!Total_Containers > 0 Then
            GROSS_INV = Nz(Round(Gross_Per_Unit_calculated * Forms!NMIS_PRODUCT_INVENTORIES![Agreement_Lot_Total_Containers subform].Form!Total_Containers / 1000, 3), 0)
        End If
    End If
    
    If Not IsNull(Forms![NMIS_PRODUCT_INVENTORIES]![NMIS_PRODUCT_INVENTORY_SAMPLES subform1].Form![Max_Sample_No]) Then
        [SAMPLES] = Nz(Forms![NMIS_PRODUCT_INVENTORIES]![NMIS_PRODUCT_INVENTORY_SAMPLES subform1].Form![Max_Sample_No], 0)
        '[SAMPLES_SPACING] = Nz([Agreement_Lot_Total_Containers subform].Form![Total_Containers], 1) / _
        '(Nz(Forms![NMIS_PRODUCT_INVENTORIES]![NMIS_PRODUCT_INVENTORY_SAMPLES subform1].Form![Max_Sample_No], 0) + 1)
     End If

        "* Matches any number of characters. It can be used as the first or last character in the character string. wh* finds what, white, and why" & Chr(13) & Chr(10) & Chr(10) & _

Private Sub CALIBRATION_REV_SOURCE_UNITS_Exit(Cancel As Integer)
 
  If Calibration_Source_Units > 0 Then
  
    Dim Source_Units As Double
    Dim Units_Per_Rev As Double
    Dim Rev_Source_Units As Double
    Dim Revs_Used As Integer
    Dim Travel_Per_Rev As Double
    Dim Total_Container_Units As Double
    Dim Min_Units_For_Sublot As Double
    Dim Increment_For_Sublot As Integer
    Dim Max_Sublots As Integer
    Dim Calibration_Sublots As Integer
    Dim Sublot_Units As Double
    
    If Forms![Oyjord_Calibration]![Ojyord_Calibration subform]![Calibration_Source_Units] >= 0 Then
        Source_Units = Forms![Oyjord_Calibration]![Ojyord_Calibration subform]![Calibration_Source_Units]
    End If
    If Forms![Oyjord_Calibration]![Ojyord_Calibration subform]![Calibration_Rev_Source_Units] >= 0 Then
        Rev_Source_Units = Forms![Oyjord_Calibration]![Ojyord_Calibration subform]![Calibration_Rev_Source_Units]
    End If
    If Forms![Oyjord_Calibration]![Ojyord_Calibration subform]![Calibration_Revs_Used] >= 0 Then
        Revs_Used = Forms![Oyjord_Calibration]![Ojyord_Calibration subform]![Calibration_Revs_Used]
    End If
    Total_Container_Units = Forms![Oyjord_Calibration]![Ojyord_Calibration subform]![EST_CONTAINERS_REQUIRED]
    Min_Units_For_Sublot = Forms![Oyjord_Calibration]![Ojyord_Calibration subform]![Min_Units_For_Sublot]
    Increment_For_Sublot = Forms![Oyjord_Calibration]![Ojyord_Calibration subform]![Increment_For_Sublot]
    Max_Sublots = Forms![Oyjord_Calibration]![Ojyord_Calibration subform]![Max_Sublots]

        If Revs_Used <> 0 And Rev_Source_Units <> 0 Then
            Units_Per_Rev = Round(Rev_Source_Units / Revs_Used, 3)
            Travel_Per_Rev = Round(Total_Container_Units / (Source_Units / Units_Per_Rev), 2)
            Forms![Oyjord_Calibration]![Ojyord_Calibration subform]![Units_Per_Rev] = Units_Per_Rev
            Forms![Oyjord_Calibration]![Ojyord_Calibration subform]![Calibration_Travel_Per_Rev] = Travel_Per_Rev
            If Total_Container_Units < Min_Units_For_Sublot Then
                Calibration_Sublots = 0
                Sublot_Units = 0
            Else
                Calibration_Sublots = (Total_Container_Units / Min_Units_For_Sublot)
                If Calibration_Sublots > Max_Sublots Then
                    Calibration_Sublots = Max_Sublots
                End If
                Sublot_Units = Round(Increment_For_Sublot / Travel_Per_Rev * Units_Per_Rev, 2)
            End If
            Forms![Oyjord_Calibration]![Ojyord_Calibration subform]![Calibration_Sublots] = Calibration_Sublots
            Forms![Oyjord_Calibration]![Ojyord_Calibration subform]![Sublot_Units] = Sublot_Units
            'Check to see if Calibrated units per rev is within range
            If [DRILL_MIN_REV_UNITS] > 0 And [DRILL_MAX_REV_UNITS] > 0 Then
                If Units_Per_Rev < [DRILL_MIN_REV_UNITS] Or Units_Per_Rev > [DRILL_MAX_REV_UNITS] Then
                    DoCmd.OpenForm "xOyjord_Calibration_Error"
                End If
            End If
        End If

        If Revs_Used <> 0 And Rev_Source_Units <> 0 Then
            Units_Per_Rev = Round(Rev_Source_Units / Revs_Used, 3)
            Travel_Per_Rev = Round(Total_Container_Units / (Source_Units / Units_Per_Rev), 2)
            Forms![Oyjord_Calibration]![Ojyord_Calibration subform]![Units_Per_Rev] = Units_Per_Rev
            Forms![Oyjord_Calibration]![Ojyord_Calibration subform]![Calibration_Travel_Per_Rev] = Travel_Per_Rev
            If Total_Container_Units < Min_Units_For_Sublot Then
                Calibration_Sublots = 0
                Sublot_Units = 0
            Else
                Calibration_Sublots = (Total_Container_Units / Min_Units_For_Sublot)
                If Calibration_Sublots > Max_Sublots Then
                    Calibration_Sublots = Max_Sublots
                End If
                Sublot_Units = Round(Increment_For_Sublot / Travel_Per_Rev * Units_Per_Rev, 2)
            End If
            Forms![Oyjord_Calibration]![Ojyord_Calibration subform]![Calibration_Sublots] = Calibration_Sublots
            Forms![Oyjord_Calibration]![Ojyord_Calibration subform]![Sublot_Units] = Sublot_Units
            
        End If
    
    End If
    [NMIS_OYJORD_SETTINGS subform].Requery
End Sub

Private Sub BEGIN_INDEX_Exit(Cancel As Integer)
    
    Dim VarX As Variant
    Dim VarY As Variant
    VarX = DLookup("[LOCATION_TYPE]", "NMIS_LOCATIONS", "CN = [Location_CN]")
    VarY = DLookup("[index_max]", "NMIS_LOCATIONS", "CN = [Location_CN]")
    If Not IsNull(BEGIN_INDEX) Then
        If (IsNull(INDEX_INCREMENT) And VarX = "FIELD") Then
            INDEX_INCREMENT = Forms![Switchboard]![NMIS_ACCESS_SET_USER_NURSERY subform].Form![Field_Index_Increment_Default]
        End If
    End If
    If BEGIN_INDEX = 999 Then
        BEGIN_INDEX = Round(VarY / Nz(INDEX_INCREMENT, 1), 1)
    End If

        END_INDEX = Beg_Index_Last
    Else
        END_INDEX.Locked = True
    End If

End Sub

Private Sub END_INDEX_Exit(Cancel As Integer)
    Dim VarX As Variant
    Dim VarY As Variant
    VarX = DLookup("[LOCATION_TYPE]", "NMIS_LOCATIONS", "CN = [Location_CN]")
    VarY = DLookup("[index_max]", "NMIS_LOCATIONS", "CN = [Location_CN]")
    
    Last_Est_Units = Est_Units
    If Not IsNull(END_INDEX) Then
        If (IsNull(INDEX_INCREMENT) And VarX = "FIELD") Then
            INDEX_INCREMENT = Forms![Switchboard]![NMIS_ACCESS_SET_USER_NURSERY subform].Form![Field_Index_Increment_Default]
        End If
        Beg_Index_Last = BEGIN_INDEX
        End_Index_Last = END_INDEX
        If SOW_DIRECTION = 1 Then
            If BEGIN_INDEX > END_INDEX Then
                temp = BEGIN_INDEX
                BEGIN_INDEX = END_INDEX
                END_INDEX = temp
                'SOWN_BACKWARDS = True
                Map_Backwards = True
            Else
                SOWN_BACKWARDS = False
                Map_Backwards = False
            End If
        Else
            If END_INDEX > BEGIN_INDEX Then
                temp = BEGIN_INDEX
                BEGIN_INDEX = END_INDEX
                END_INDEX = temp
                'SOWN_BACKWARDS = True
                Map_Backwards = True
            Else
                SOWN_BACKWARDS = False
                Map_Backwards = False
            End If
        End If
        If END_INDEX = 999 Then
            END_INDEX = Round(VarY / Nz(INDEX_INCREMENT, 1), 1)
        End If
    End If
        
End Sub

        'End If
        
        If [Activity_Code] = "CPROC" Then
                cid = "2.6"

        'If cid <> "2.5" Then
            'If [Total_Order] >= 7 Then

                'cid = cid & "b"
            'End If
        'End If
        If Not IsNull(cid) Then
            CONTRACT_ITEM = cid
        End If
        End If
    Case Is = "050357"
        If IsNull(CONTRACT_ITEM) Then
            If [Activity_Code] = "cproc" Then
                cid = "2"
            Else
            If [Activity_Code] Like "PXPLT*" Then
                cid = "na"
            Else
            If [Activity_Code] = "PACK" Then
                If [NMIS_PROCESSING_ORDERS_ID_INFO subform].Form![PRODUCT_DESC] Like "*1+0*" Then
                    cid = "1E"
                Else
                    If [NMIS_PROCESSING_ORDERS_ID_INFO subform].Form![PRODUCT_DESC] Like "*2+0*" Then

                    Else

                            cid = "1H"
                        End If

            End If
            End If
        End If
        If Not IsNull(cid) Then
            CONTRACT_ITEM = cid

    Case Is = "040207"
        If IsNull(CONTRACT_ITEM) Then
            If [Activity_Code] = "CPROC" Then
                cid = "3"
            Else
            If [Activity_Code] = "PACK" Then
                    cid = "2"
            End If
            End If
        End If
        If Not IsNull(cid) Then
            CONTRACT_ITEM = cid
        End If
    End Select

vba.Form_Lookup_Tables_Menu Subform:
Option Compare Database

Private Sub Form_Open(Cancel As Integer)
' Minimize the database window and initialize the form.

    ' Move to the switchboard page that is marked as the default.
    Me.Filter = "[ItemNumber] = 0 AND [Argument] = 'Default' "
    Me.FilterOn = True
    
End Sub

Private Sub Form_Current()
' Update the caption and fill in the list of options.

    Me.Caption = Nz(Me![ItemText], "")
    FillOptions
    
End Sub

Private Sub FillOptions()
' Fill in the options for this switchboard page.

    ' The number of buttons on the form.
    Const conNumButtons = 8
    
    Dim con As Object
    Dim rs As Object
    Dim stSql As String
    Dim intOption As Integer
    
    ' Set the focus to the first button on the form,
    ' and then hide all of the buttons on the form
    ' but the first.  You can't hide the field with the focus.
    Me![Option1].SetFocus
    For intOption = 2 To conNumButtons
        Me("Option" & intOption).Visible = False
        Me("OptionLabel" & intOption).Visible = False
    Next intOption
    
    ' Open the table of Switchboard Items, and find
    ' the first item for this Switchboard Page.
    Set con = Application.CurrentProject.Connection
    stSql = "SELECT * FROM [Switchboard Items]"
    stSql = stSql & " WHERE [ItemNumber] > 0 AND [SwitchboardID]=" & Me![SwitchboardID]
    stSql = stSql & " ORDER BY [ItemNumber];"
    Set rs = CreateObject("ADODB.Recordset")
    rs.Open stSql, con, 1   ' 1 = adOpenKeyset
    
    ' If there are no options for this Switchboard Page,
    ' display a message.  Otherwise, fill the page with the items.
    If (rs.EOF) Then
        Me![OptionLabel1].Caption = "There are no items for this switchboard page"
    Else
        While (Not (rs.EOF))
            Me("Option" & rs![ItemNumber]).Visible = True
            Me("OptionLabel" & rs![ItemNumber]).Visible = True
            Me("OptionLabel" & rs![ItemNumber]).Caption = rs![ItemText]
            rs.MoveNext
        Wend
    End If

    ' Close the recordset and the database.
    rs.Close
    Set rs = Nothing
    Set con = Nothing

End Sub

Private Function HandleButtonClick(intBtn As Integer)
' This function is called when a button is clicked.
' intBtn indicates which button was clicked.

    ' Constants for the commands that can be executed.
    Const conCmdGotoSwitchboard = 1
    Const conCmdOpenFormAdd = 2
    Const conCmdOpenFormBrowse = 3
    Const conCmdOpenReport = 4
    Const conCmdCustomizeSwitchboard = 5
    Const conCmdExitApplication = 6
    Const conCmdRunMacro = 7
    Const conCmdRunCode = 8
    Const conCmdOpenPage = 9

    ' An error that is special cased.
    Const conErrDoCmdCancelled = 2501
    
    Dim con As Object
    Dim rs As Object
    Dim stSql As String

On Error GoTo HandleButtonClick_Err

    ' Find the item in the Switchboard Items table
    ' that corresponds to the button that was clicked.
    Set con = Application.CurrentProject.Connection
    Set rs = CreateObject("ADODB.Recordset")
    stSql = "SELECT * FROM [Switchboard Items] "
    stSql = stSql & "WHERE [SwitchboardID]=" & Me![SwitchboardID] & " AND [ItemNumber]=" & intBtn
    rs.Open stSql, con, 1    ' 1 = adOpenKeyset
    
    ' If no item matches, report the error and exit the function.
    If (rs.EOF) Then
        MsgBox "There was an error reading the Switchboard Items table."
        rs.Close
        Set rs = Nothing
        Set con = Nothing
        Exit Function
    End If
    
    Select Case rs![Command]
        
        ' Go to another switchboard.
        Case conCmdGotoSwitchboard
            Me.Filter = "[ItemNumber] = 0 AND [SwitchboardID]=" & rs![Argument]
            
        ' Open a form in Add mode.
        Case conCmdOpenFormAdd
            DoCmd.OpenForm rs![Argument], , , , acAdd

        ' Open a form.
        Case conCmdOpenFormBrowse
            DoCmd.OpenForm rs![Argument]

        ' Open a report.
        Case conCmdOpenReport
            DoCmd.OpenReport rs![Argument], acPreview

        ' Customize the Switchboard.
        Case conCmdCustomizeSwitchboard
            ' Handle the case where the Switchboard Manager
            ' is not installed (e.g. Minimal Install).
            On Error Resume Next
            Application.Run "ACWZMAIN.sbm_Entry"
            If (Err <> 0) Then MsgBox "Command not available."
            On Error GoTo 0
            ' Update the form.
            Me.Filter = "[ItemNumber] = 0 AND [Argument] = 'Default' "
            Me.Caption = Nz(Me![ItemText], "")
            FillOptions

        ' Exit the application.
        Case conCmdExitApplication
            CloseCurrentDatabase

        ' Run a macro.
        Case conCmdRunMacro
            DoCmd.RunMacro rs![Argument]

        ' Run code.
        Case conCmdRunCode
            Application.Run rs![Argument]

        ' Open a Data Access Page
        Case conCmdOpenPage
            DoCmd.OpenDataAccessPage rs![Argument]

        ' Any other command is unrecognized.
        Case Else
            MsgBox "Unknown option."
    
    End Select

    ' Close the recordset and the database.
    rs.Close
    
HandleButtonClick_Exit:
On Error Resume Next
    Set rs = Nothing
    Set con = Nothing
    Exit Function

HandleButtonClick_Err:
    ' If the action was cancelled by the user for
    ' some reason, don't display an error message.
    ' Instead, resume on the next line.
    If (Err = conErrDoCmdCancelled) Then
        Resume Next
    Else
        MsgBox "There was an error executing the command.", vbCritical
        Resume HandleButtonClick_Exit
    End If
    
End Function
